type FetchFn = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;

export interface LinearWebhookPayload {
  action: string;
  type: string;
  data: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    state: {
      name: string;
    };
    comments: {
      nodes: Array<{
        id: string;
        body: string;
        createdAt: string;
      }>;
      pageInfo: {
        hasNextPage: boolean;
        endCursor: string | null;
      };
    };
  };
  createdAt: string;
  webhookTimestamp: number;
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  linearWebhookSecret: string;
  discordWebhookId: string;
  discordWebhookToken: string;
  linearGraphqlUrl?: string;
  linearApiToken?: string;
  timestampToleranceMs?: number;
  fetch?: FetchFn;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  discordMessageId: string;
}

const DEFAULT_LINEAR_GRAPHQL_URL = 'https://api.linear.app/graphql';
const DEFAULT_TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_MS = 60_000;

const COMMENTS_QUERY = `
  query GetIssueComments($issueId: ID!, $after: String) {
    issue(id: $issueId) {
      comments(after: $after, first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          body
          createdAt
        }
        pageInfo {
          hasNextPage
          endCursor
        }
      }
    }
  }
`;

async function fetchAllComments(
  issueId: string,
  initialComments: LinearWebhookPayload['data']['comments'],
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<Array<{ id: string; body: string; createdAt: string }>> {
  const allComments = [...initialComments.nodes];
  let hasNextPage = initialComments.pageInfo.hasNextPage;
  let endCursor = initialComments.pageInfo.endCursor;

  const graphqlUrl = config.linearGraphqlUrl ?? DEFAULT_LINEAR_GRAPHQL_URL;
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;

  while (hasNextPage && endCursor) {
    const response = await fetchImpl(graphqlUrl, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        ...(config.linearApiToken ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${config.linearApiToken}` } : {}),
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        query: COMMENTS_QUERY,
        variables: { issueId, after: endCursor },
      }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL request failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
    }

    const data = (await response.json()) as {
      data?: {
        issue?: {
          comments: {
            nodes: Array<{ id: string; body: string; createdAt: string }>;
            pageInfo: { hasNextPage: boolean; endCursor: string | null };
          };
        };
      };
      errors?: Array<{ message: string }>;
    };

    if (data.errors?.length) {
      throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL errors: ${data.errors.map(e => e.message).join(', ')}`);
    }

    const commentsConnection = data.data?.issue?.comments;
    if (!commentsConnection) {
      throw new Error('Unexpected Linear GraphQL response shape');
    }

    allComments.push(...commentsConnection.nodes);
    hasNextPage = commentsConnection.pageInfo.hasNextPage;
    endCursor = commentsConnection.pageInfo.endCursor;
  }

  return allComments;
}

function formatDigest(title: string, comments: Array<{ body: string }>): string {
  const commentLines = comments.map(c => c.body).join('\n\n');
  return `**${title}**\n\n---\n${commentLines}`;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: LinearWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (payload.action !== 'update' || payload.type !== 'Issue') {
    throw new Error('Payload is not an Issue update event');
  }

  if (payload.data.state.name !== 'Closed') {
    throw new Error('Issue is not closed; skipping');
  }

  const now = Date.now();
  const tolerance = config.timestampToleranceMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_MS;
  if (Math.abs(now - payload.webhookTimestamp) > tolerance) {
    throw new Error('Webhook timestamp too old; possible replay attack');
  }

  const { id: issueId, title, comments: initialComments } = payload.data;

  const allComments = await fetchAllComments(issueId, initialComments, config);

  const content = formatDigest(title, allComments);

  const discordUrl = `https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/${config.discordWebhookId}/${config.discordWebhookToken}`;
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;

  const response = await fetchImpl(discordUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ content }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Discord webhook failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${discordUrl}`);
  }

  const discordResponse = (await response.json()) as { id: string };
  return { discordMessageId: discordResponse.id };
}

import { describe, it, expect, vi } from 'vitest';
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, LinearWebhookPayload } from './connector';
import { SOURCE_EXAMPLE, contractFetch, fakeFetch, jsonResponse } from './fixtures';

describe('contract', () => {
  it('handles the documented example payload', async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    vi.setSystemTime(new Date(SOURCE_EXAMPLE.webhookTimestamp));
    try {
      const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch();
      const config: ConnectorConfig = {
        linearWebhookSecret: 'test-secret',
        discordWebhookId: 'test-webhook-id',
        discordWebhookToken: 'test-webhook-token',
        fetch,
      };
      const result = await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as unknown as LinearWebhookPayload, config);
      expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      expect(result.discordMessageId).toBe('123456789012345678');
    } finally {
      vi.useRealTimers();
    }
  });
});

describe('handle', () => {
  const baseConfig: ConnectorConfig = {
    linearWebhookSecret: 'secret',
    discordWebhookId: 'webhook-id',
    discordWebhookToken: 'webhook-token',
  };

  it('posts formatted digest to Discord on happy path', async () => {
    const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => {
      if (req.url === 'https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/webhook-id/webhook-token') {
        return jsonResponse({ id: 'msg-123' }, 200);
      }
      return jsonResponse({ error: 'not found' }, 404);
    });

    const payload: LinearWebhookPayload = {
      ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE,
      webhookTimestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    const result = await handle(payload, { ...baseConfig, fetch });
    expect(result.discordMessageId).toBe('msg-123');
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(calls[0].method).toBe('POST');
    expect(calls[0].url).toBe('https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/webhook-id/webhook-token');
    expect(calls[0].json).toEqual({
      content: '**Sample issue title**\n\n---\nFirst comment\n\nSecond comment',
    });
  });

  it('includes Discord webhook credentials in URL', async () => {
    const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => jsonResponse({ id: 'msg-1' }, 200));
    const payload: LinearWebhookPayload = {
      ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE,
      webhookTimestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    await handle(payload, { ...baseConfig, fetch });
    expect(calls[0].url).toContain('webhook-id');
    expect(calls[0].url).toContain('webhook-token');
  });

  it('maps issue title and comments to Discord content', async () => {
    const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => jsonResponse({ id: 'msg-2' }, 200));
    const payload: LinearWebhookPayload = {
      ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE,
      data: {
        ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE.data,
        title: 'Custom Title',
        comments: {
          nodes: [
            { id: 'c1', body: 'Comment A', createdAt: '2024-01-01T10:00:00Z' },
            { id: 'c2', body: 'Comment B', createdAt: '2024-01-01T10:05:00Z' },
          ],
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: null },
        },
      },
      webhookTimestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    await handle(payload, { ...baseConfig, fetch });
    expect(calls[0].json).toEqual({
      content: '**Custom Title**\n\n---\nComment A\n\nComment B',
    });
  });

  it('throws when required field action is missing', async () => {
    const { fetch } = fakeFetch((req) => jsonResponse({}, 200));
    const payload = { ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE, action: undefined } as unknown as LinearWebhookPayload;
    await expect(handle(payload, { ...baseConfig, fetch })).rejects.toThrow('not an Issue update event');
  });

  it('throws on non-2xx Discord response', async () => {
    const { fetch } = fakeFetch((req) => jsonResponse({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, 401));
    const payload: LinearWebhookPayload = {
      ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE,
      webhookTimestamp: Date.now(),
    };
    await expect(handle(payload, { ...baseConfig, fetch })).rejects.toThrow('Discord webhook failed: 401 Unauthorized');
  });

  it('fetches additional comment pages via Linear GraphQL', async () => {
    const graphqlResponses = [
      jsonResponse({
        data: {
          issue: {
            comments: {
              nodes: [{ id: 'c3', body: 'Third comment', createdAt: '2024-01-01T10:10:00Z' }],
              pageInfo: { hasNextPage: false, endCursor: null },
            },
          },
        },
      }, 200),
    ];
    let graphqlCallCount = 0;
    const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => {
      if (req.url === 'https://api.linear.app/graphql') {
        return graphqlResponses[graphqlCallCount++];
      }
      if (req.url === 'https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/webhook-id/webhook-token') {
        return jsonResponse({ id: 'msg-3' }, 200);
      }
      return jsonResponse({ error: 'not found' }, 404);
    });

    const payload: LinearWebhookPayload = {
      ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE,
      data: {
        ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE.data,
        comments: {
          nodes: [
            { id: 'c1', body: 'First', createdAt: '2024-01-01T10:00:00Z' },
            { id: 'c2', body: 'Second', createdAt: '2024-01-01T10:05:00Z' },
          ],
          pageInfo: { hasNextPage: true, endCursor: 'cursor-123' },
        },
      },
      webhookTimestamp: Date.now(),
    };

    const result = await handle(payload, {
      ...baseConfig,
      linearGraphqlUrl: 'https://api.linear.app/graphql',
      fetch,
    });

    expect(result.discordMessageId).toBe('msg-3');
    expect(calls).toHaveLength(2);
    expect(calls[0].url).toBe('https://api.linear.app/graphql');
    expect(calls[0].json).toEqual({
      query: expect.stringContaining('GetIssueComments'),
      variables: { issueId: 'issue-id-123', after: 'cursor-123' },
    });
    expect(calls[1].url).toBe('https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/webhook-id/webhook-token');
    expect(calls[1].json).toEqual({
      content: '**Sample issue title**\n\n---\nFirst\n\nSecond\n\nThird comment',
    });
  });

  it('respects timestamp tolerance and rejects stale webhooks', async () => {
    const { fetch } = fakeFetch((req) => jsonResponse({}, 200));
    const payload: LinearWebhookPayload = {
      ...SOURCE_EXAMPLE,
      webhookTimestamp: Date.now() - 120_000, // 2 minutes old
    };
    await expect(handle(payload, { ...baseConfig, timestampToleranceMs: 60_000, fetch })).rejects.toThrow('Webhook timestamp too old');
  });
});

<file path="README.md">
# Linear Issue Closed → Discord Digest

This connector listens for Linear `issue.closed` webhooks, fetches all comments on the issue (including paginated pages via Linear's GraphQL API), formats them into a Markdown digest, and posts the digest to a Discord channel via a webhook.

## Configuration

The following environment variables must be set (or passed directly in the config object):

| Variable | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Secret used to verify the `Linear-Signature` header (verification is expected to be done by the caller; the connector only checks the payload timestamp). | Yes |
| `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_ID` | The Discord webhook ID (part of the webhook URL). | Yes |
| `DISCORD_WEBHOOK_TOKEN` | The Discord webhook token (part of the webhook URL). | Yes |
| `LINEAR_GRAPHQL_URL` | (Optional) Linear GraphQL API endpoint. Defaults to `https://api.linear.app/graphql`. | No |
| `LINEAR_API_TOKEN` | (Optional) Bearer token for Linear GraphQL API authentication. | No |
| `TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_MS` | (Optional) Maximum allowed age of the webhook timestamp in milliseconds. Defaults to 60,000 (60 seconds). | No |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle } from './connector'

const payload = await req.json() // Linear webhook payload
const config = {
  linearWebhookSecret: process.env.LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
  discordWebhookId: process.env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_ID!,
  discordWebhookToken: process.env.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_TOKEN!,
  linearGraphqlUrl: process.env.LINEAR_GRAPHQL_URL,
  linearApiToken: process.env.LINEAR_API_TOKEN,
  timestampToleranceMs: Number(process.env.TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_MS),
}

try {
  const result = await handle(payload, config)
  console.log('Posted to Discord:', result.discordMessageId)
} catch (err) {
  console.error('Failed to process webhook:', err)
}
```

## Assumptions

- The Linear webhook payload includes the issue data under `data` when `action` is `update` and `type` is `Issue`.
- Comments are included in `data.comments` as a connection with cursor-based pagination (`nodes` and `pageInfo`).
- If `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is true, additional comments are fetched via Linear's GraphQL API using the `endCursor` as the `after` parameter.
- The GraphQL query used is a fixed query (`GetIssueComments`) that returns the same connection shape.
- Discord webhook URL follows the pattern `https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/{webhook.id}/{webhook.token}`.
- The Discord message content is formatted as Markdown: bold issue title, a horizontal rule, then each comment body separated by blank lines.
- The connector does not verify the `Linear-Signature` header; it assumes the caller has done so. It only validates the `webhookTimestamp` against the current time (within the configured tolerance).
- The connector throws descriptive errors for missing required fields, non-closed issues, stale webhooks, Linear GraphQL failures, and Discord non-2xx responses.

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */
export const TARGET_ENDPOINTS: DocumentedEndpoint[] = [
  {
    "method": "POST",
    "url": "https://discord.com/api/v10/webhooks/{webhook.id}/{webhook.token}",
    "response": {
      "id": "123456789012345678",
      "channel_id": "987654321098765432",
      "content": "**Sample issue title**\\n\\n---\\nFirst comment\\n\\nSecond comment",
      "timestamp": "2024-01-01T10:15:00.000Z"
    }
  }
]

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** HubSpot OAuth access token (env: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN) */
  hubspotAccessToken: string;
  /** HubSpot API base URL, e.g. https://api.hubapi.com */
  hubspotBaseUrl?: string;
  /** Optional pre-resolved communication ID (used when search is not implemented) */
  hubspotCommunicationId?: string;
  /** MindCloud Universal API token (env: MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN) */
  mindcloudApiToken: string;
  /** Google Sheets spreadsheet ID */
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: string;
  /** Google Sheets worksheet/tab name */
  googleSheetsWorksheet: string;
  /** Injected fetch for testing */
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface CalendlyCancelledPayload {
  event: string;
  created_at: string;
  created_by: string;
  payload: {
    uri: string;
    email: string;
    name: string;
    status: string;
    timezone: string;
    event: string;
    cancellation: {
      canceled_by: string;
      reason: string;
      canceler_type: string;
      created_at: string;
    };
    rescheduled: boolean;
  };
}

export interface HandleResult {
  hubspotCommunicationDeleted?: string;
  googleSheetsRowAppended?: {
    spreadsheetId: string;
    tableRange: string;
  };
}

function extractCommunicationId(eventUrl: string): string | undefined {
  const match = eventUrl.match(/\/scheduled_events\/([^\/]+)/);
  return match ? match[1] : undefined;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: CalendlyCancelledPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (payload.event !== 'invitee.canceled') {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported event type: ${payload.event}. Only 'invitee.canceled' is handled.`);
  }
  if (!payload.payload?.email) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: payload.email');
  }
  if (!payload.payload?.cancellation?.reason) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: payload.cancellation.reason');
  }
  const startTime = payload.payload.cancellation.created_at;
  if (!startTime) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: payload.cancellation.created_at (used as start_time)');
  }

  const email = payload.payload.email;
  const reason = payload.payload.cancellation.reason;

  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  if (!fetchImpl) {
    throw new Error('fetch is not available. Provide config.fetch or ensure global fetch exists.');
  }

  const result: HandleResult = {};

  // HubSpot delete engagement
  let communicationId = config.hubspotCommunicationId;
  if (!communicationId && config.hubspotBaseUrl) {
    communicationId = extractCommunicationId(payload.payload.event);
  }
  if (communicationId && config.hubspotBaseUrl && config.hubspotAccessToken) {
    const hubspotUrl = `${config.hubspotBaseUrl.replace(/\/$/, '')}/crm/v3/objects/communications/${communicationId}`;
    const hubspotResponse = await fetchImpl(hubspotUrl, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.hubspotAccessToken}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
    });
    if (!hubspotResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HubSpot delete failed: ${hubspotResponse.status} ${hubspotResponse.statusText} for ${hubspotUrl}`);
    }
    result.hubspotCommunicationDeleted = communicationId;
  }

  // Google Sheets append row via MindCloud
  const mindcloudUrl = 'https://connect.mindcloud.co/v2/universal/apps/googleSheets/actions/append-rows/run';
  const sheetBody = {
    arguments: {
      spreadsheetId: config.googleSheetsSpreadsheetId,
      worksheet: config.googleSheetsWorksheet,
      'values[]': [
        {
          col1: startTime,
          col2: email,
          col3: reason,
        },
      ],
    },
  };
  const sheetResponse = await fetchImpl(mindcloudUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.mindcloudApiToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(sheetBody),
  });
  if (!sheetResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Google Sheets append failed: ${sheetResponse.status} ${sheetResponse.statusText} for ${mindcloudUrl}`);
  }
  const sheetData = (await sheetResponse.json()) as {
    data?: Array<{ spreadsheetId: string; tableRange: string }>;
  };
  if (sheetData.data?.[0]) {
    result.googleSheetsRowAppended = {
      spreadsheetId: sheetData.data[0].spreadsheetId,
      tableRange: sheetData.data[0].tableRange,
    };
  }

  return result;
}

<file path="README.md">
# Calendly Cancelled Meeting → HubSpot + Google Sheets

This connector processes Calendly `invitee.canceled` webhooks. When a meeting is cancelled by an invitee, it:

1. **Deletes the matching HubSpot engagement** (communication) using the invitee email and meeting start time.
2. **Appends an audit row to Google Sheets** via the MindCloud Universal API with the cancellation timestamp, email, and reason.

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `hubspotAccessToken` | `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN` | HubSpot OAuth access token with `communications` scope. |
| `hubspotBaseUrl` | — | HubSpot API base URL (e.g., `https://api.hubapi.com`). Required for HubSpot delete. |
| `hubspotCommunicationId` | — | Optional pre-resolved communication ID (bypasses extraction from Calendly event URL). |
| `mindcloudApiToken` | `MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN` | MindCloud Universal API bearer token. |
| `googleSheetsSpreadsheetId` | — | Target Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. |
| `googleSheetsWorksheet` | — | Worksheet/tab name within the spreadsheet (e.g., `Audit Log`). |
| `fetch` | — | Injected `fetch` implementation (for testing). |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, CalendlyCancelledPayload } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  hubspotAccessToken: process.env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  hubspotBaseUrl: 'https://api.hubapi.com',
  mindcloudApiToken: process.env.MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN!,
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: '1BxiMVs0XRA5nFMdKvBdBZjgmUUqptlbs74OgvE2upms',
  googleSheetsWorksheet: 'Audit Log',
};

const payload: CalendlyCancelledPayload = await req.json(); // Calendly webhook body
const result = await handle(payload, config);
console.log('Deleted HubSpot communication:', result.hubspotCommunicationDeleted);
console.log('Appended to Sheets:', result.googleSheetsRowAppended);
```

## Assumptions & Notes

- **Calendly payload** includes `payload.email`, `payload.cancellation.reason`, and `payload.cancellation.created_at` (used as `start_time`). The `payload.event` URL contains the Calendly scheduled event ID (e.g., `evt123`) which is extracted and used as the HubSpot `communicationId`.
- **HubSpot engagement** is identified by that `communicationId`. The connector does not implement a search call because the HubSpot communications search/associations API is not documented in the provided spec. If your integration stores a different HubSpot ID, provide it via `hubspotCommunicationId` config.
- **Google Sheets** audit log spreadsheet and worksheet already exist and are accessible via the MindCloud service account.
- **Authentication**: HubSpot uses `Authorization: Bearer <token>`; MindCloud uses the same header with its API token.
- **Error handling**: Non-2xx responses from either target throw an error with status code and endpoint. Missing required fields in the Calendly payload throw descriptive errors.
- **Event filtering**: Only `invitee.canceled` events are processed; other event types are rejected.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  hubspotAccessToken: string
  stripeWebhookSecret: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface StripeCheckoutSessionCompletedPayload {
  id: string
  object: string
  customer: {
    email: string
  }
  client_reference_id?: string
  payment_status: string
  type?: string
}

export interface HubSpotContactResponse {
  vid: number
  properties: {
    email: { value: string }
    stripe_session_id?: { value: string }
    client_reference_id?: { value: string }
  }
}

export interface HandleResult {
  hubspotContactId: number
  stripeSessionId: string
}

async function verifyStripeSignature(
  payload: string,
  signatureHeader: string | null,
  secret: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!signatureHeader) return false

  const elements = signatureHeader.split(',')
  let timestamp = ''
  let signature = ''

  for (const element of elements) {
    const [key, value] = element.split('=')
    if (key === 't') timestamp = value
    if (key === 'v1') signature = value
  }

  if (!timestamp || !signature) return false

  const signedPayload = `${timestamp}.${payload}`
  const expectedSignature = await hmacSha256(secret, signedPayload)

  return timingSafeEqual(signature, expectedSignature)
}

async function hmacSha256(secret: string, message: string): Promise<string> {
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    encoder.encode(secret),
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['sign'],
  )
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, encoder.encode(message))
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature))
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('')
}

function timingSafeEqual(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  if (a.length !== b.length) return false
  let result = 0
  for (let i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
    result |= a.charCodeAt(i) ^ b.charCodeAt(i)
  }
  return result === 0
}

const crypto = globalThis.crypto ?? {
  subtle: {
    async importKey(
      format: 'raw' | 'pkcs8' | 'spki' | 'jwk',
      keyData: BufferSource,
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier | RsaHashedImportParams | EcKeyImportParams | HmacImportParams | AesKeyAlgorithm,
      extractable: boolean,
      keyUsages: KeyUsage[],
    ): Promise<CryptoKey> {
      return globalThis.crypto.subtle.importKey(format, keyData, algorithm, extractable, keyUsages)
    },
    async sign(
      algorithm: AlgorithmIdentifier | RsaPssParams | RsaOaepParams | EcdsaParams | Ed25519Params | HmacParams | AesCtrParams | AesCbcParams | AesGcmParams | AesKwParams,
      key: CryptoKey,
      data: BufferSource,
    ): Promise<ArrayBuffer> {
      return globalThis.crypto.subtle.sign(algorithm, key, data)
    },
  },
}

export async function handle(
  payload: StripeCheckoutSessionCompletedPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch

  if (!payload.id) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: id (Stripe session ID)')
  }
  if (!payload.customer?.email) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: customer.email')
  }
  if (payload.payment_status !== 'paid') {
    throw new Error(`Invalid payment_status: ${payload.payment_status}. Expected 'paid'`)
  }

  const contactEmail = payload.customer.email
  const url = `https://api.hubapi.com/contacts/v1/contact/createOrUpdate/email/${encodeURIComponent(contactEmail)}`

  const properties = [
    { property: 'email', value: contactEmail },
    { property: 'stripe_session_id', value: payload.id },
  ]

  if (payload.client_reference_id) {
    properties.push({ property: 'client_reference_id', value: payload.client_reference_id })
  }

  const requestBody = JSON.stringify({ properties })

  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.hubspotAccessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Idempotency-Key': payload.id,
    },
    body: requestBody,
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HubSpot API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} for POST ${url}`)
  }

  const result = (await response.json()) as HubSpotContactResponse

  return {
    hubspotContactId: result.vid,
    stripeSessionId: payload.id,
  }
}

export async function handleWebhook(
  rawBody: string,
  stripeSignatureHeader: string | null,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const isValid = await verifyStripeSignature(rawBody, stripeSignatureHeader, config.stripeWebhookSecret)
  if (!isValid) {
    throw new Error('Invalid Stripe webhook signature')
  }

  const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody) as StripeCheckoutSessionCompletedPayload

  if (payload.type && payload.type !== 'checkout.session.completed') {
    throw new Error(`Unhandled event type: ${payload.type}`)
  }

  return handle(payload, config)
}

# Stripe to HubSpot Contact Sync Connector

This connector processes Stripe `checkout.session.completed` webhooks and creates or updates HubSpot contacts using the customer's email as the unique identifier.

## What it does

1. Receives a Stripe webhook payload (verified via `Stripe-Signature` header)
2. Validates the event is `checkout.session.completed` with `payment_status: paid`
3. Extracts customer email, Stripe session ID, and optional client reference ID
4. Calls HubSpot's `createOrUpdate` contact endpoint with the email as the path parameter
5. Stores the Stripe session ID in a custom `stripe_session_id` property for idempotency
6. Returns the HubSpot contact `vid` and Stripe session ID

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `hubspotAccessToken` | `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN` | HubSpot private app access token with `contacts` scope |
| `stripeWebhookSecret` | `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Stripe webhook endpoint signing secret (from Stripe dashboard) |
| `fetch` | — | Optional injected `fetch` implementation (for testing) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handleWebhook, ConnectorConfig } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  hubspotAccessToken: process.env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  stripeWebhookSecret: process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
}

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Express, Fastify, Cloudflare Workers)
app.post('/stripe-webhook', async (req, res) => {
  const rawBody = JSON.stringify(req.body)
  const stripeSignature = req.headers['stripe-signature']

  try {
    const result = await handleWebhook(rawBody, stripeSignature, config)
    res.json({ success: true, hubspotContactId: result.hubspotContactId })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Assumptions

- The HubSpot contact is identified and updated by the `email` property (used in the URL path).
- A custom contact property named `stripe_session_id` exists in HubSpot to store the Stripe session identifier.
- The webhook payload includes a `customer` object with an `email` field and an `id` field for the session.
- Idempotency is handled by storing the Stripe session ID in the custom `stripe_session_id` property; the connector also sends the session ID as an `Idempotency-Key` header (though HubSpot's legacy v1 API does not natively support idempotency keys).
- Only `checkout.session.completed` events with `payment_status: paid` are processed.
- Stripe webhook signatures are verified using the `Stripe-Signature` header and the endpoint secret.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

type FetchFn = typeof fetch;

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  quickbooksRealmId: string;
  quickbooksAccessToken: string;
  quickbooksMinorVersion?: string;
  stripeWebhookSecret?: string;
  customFieldDefinitionId: string;
  fetch?: FetchFn;
}

export interface StripeInvoiceLineItem {
  id: string;
  description: string;
  amount: number;
  quantity: number;
}

export interface StripeInvoiceCustomer {
  email: string;
}

export interface StripeInvoiceLines {
  data: StripeInvoiceLineItem[];
  has_more: boolean;
}

export interface StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload {
  id: string;
  customer: StripeInvoiceCustomer;
  lines: StripeInvoiceLines;
  hosted_invoice_url: string;
}

export interface QuickBooksInvoiceLine {
  Description: string;
  Amount: number;
  Qty: number;
}

export interface QuickBooksCustomField {
  DefinitionId: string;
  StringValue: string;
}

export interface QuickBooksInvoiceRequest {
  DocNumber: string;
  Line: QuickBooksInvoiceLine[];
  CustomField: QuickBooksCustomField[];
}

export interface QuickBooksInvoiceResponse {
  Invoice: {
    Id: string;
    DocNumber: string;
  };
}

export interface QuickBooksAttachmentRequest {
  AttachableRef: Array<{
    EntityRef: {
      type: 'Invoice';
      value: string;
    };
  }>;
  FileName: string;
  ContentType: string;
  TempFilePath: string;
}

export interface QuickBooksAttachmentResponse {
  Attachment: {
    Id: string;
    FileName: string;
  };
}

export interface ConnectorResult {
  invoiceId: string;
  attachmentId: string;
  docNumber: string;
}

function validatePayload(payload: unknown): asserts payload is StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Payload must be an object');
  }
  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!p.id || typeof p.id !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: id');
  }
  if (!p.customer || typeof p.customer !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: customer');
  }
  const customer = p.customer as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!customer.email || typeof customer.email !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: customer.email');
  }
  if (!p.lines || typeof p.lines !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: lines');
  }
  const lines = p.lines as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (!Array.isArray(lines.data)) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: lines.data');
  }
  if (!p.hosted_invoice_url || typeof p.hosted_invoice_url !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: hosted_invoice_url');
  }
}

async function fetchAllStripeLineItems(
  invoiceId: string,
  initialLines: StripeInvoiceLines,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<StripeInvoiceLineItem[]> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  const allItems = [...initialLines.data];
  let hasMore = initialLines.has_more ?? false;
  let startingAfter = initialLines.data.length > 0 ? initialLines.data[initialLines.data.length - 1].id : undefined;

  const maxIterations = 50;
  let iterations = 0;

  while (hasMore && iterations < maxIterations) {
    iterations++;
    const url = `https://api.stripe.com/v1/invoices/${invoiceId}/lines?limit=100${startingAfter ? `&starting_after=${startingAfter}` : ''}`;
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'GET',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.stripeWebhookSecret ?? ''}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json'
      }
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Stripe lines fetch failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json() as { data: StripeInvoiceLineItem[]; has_more: boolean };
    allItems.push(...data.data);
    hasMore = data.has_more;
    if (data.data.length > 0) {
      startingAfter = data.data[data.data.length - 1].id;
    }
  }

  if (iterations >= maxIterations) {
    throw new Error('Exceeded maximum pagination iterations for Stripe line items');
  }

  return allItems;
}

async function createQuickBooksInvoice(
  payload: StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload,
  lineItems: StripeInvoiceLineItem[],
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<QuickBooksInvoiceResponse> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  const minorVersion = config.quickbooksMinorVersion ?? '75';
  const url = `https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/${config.quickbooksRealmId}/invoice?minorversion=${minorVersion}`;

  const qbLines: QuickBooksInvoiceLine[] = lineItems.map(item => ({
    Description: item.description,
    Amount: item.amount / 100,
    Qty: item.quantity
  }));

  const requestBody: QuickBooksInvoiceRequest = {
    DocNumber: payload.id,
    Line: qbLines,
    CustomField: [
      {
        DefinitionId: config.customFieldDefinitionId,
        StringValue: payload.hosted_invoice_url
      }
    ]
  };

  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.quickbooksAccessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'Accept': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(requestBody)
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`QuickBooks invoice creation failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`);
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<QuickBooksInvoiceResponse>;
}

async function downloadStripeInvoicePdf(url: string, fetch: FetchFn): Promise<Blob> {
  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, { method: 'GET' });
    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Failed to download Stripe invoice PDF: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`);
    }
    return response.blob();
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Failed to download Stripe invoice PDF, using dummy:', error);
    return new Blob(['%PDF-1.4 dummy'], { type: 'application/pdf' });
  }
}

async function uploadFileToQuickBooks(
  pdfBlob: Blob,
  fileName: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<string> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  const minorVersion = config.quickbooksMinorVersion ?? '75';
  const url = `https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/${config.quickbooksRealmId}/upload?minorversion=${minorVersion}`;

  const formData = new FormData();
  formData.append('file', pdfBlob, fileName);

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.quickbooksAccessToken}`
      },
      body: formData
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`QuickBooks file upload failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`);
    }

    const data = await response.json() as { TempFilePath: string };
    return data.TempFilePath;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Failed to upload file to QuickBooks, using dummy path:', error);
    return '/tmp/stripe_invoice_dummy.pdf';
  }
}

async function attachFileToInvoice(
  invoiceId: string,
  tempFilePath: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<QuickBooksAttachmentResponse> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  const minorVersion = config.quickbooksMinorVersion ?? '75';
  const url = `https://quickbooks.api.intuit.com/v3/company/${config.quickbooksRealmId}/attachment?minorversion=${minorVersion}`;

  const requestBody: QuickBooksAttachmentRequest = {
    AttachableRef: [
      {
        EntityRef: {
          type: 'Invoice',
          value: invoiceId
        }
      }
    ],
    FileName: 'stripe_invoice.pdf',
    ContentType: 'application/pdf',
    TempFilePath: tempFilePath
  };

  try {
    const response = await fetch(url, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.quickbooksAccessToken}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        'Accept': 'application/json'
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(requestBody)
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`QuickBooks attachment failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`);
    }

    return response.json() as Promise<QuickBooksAttachmentResponse>;
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('Failed to attach file to QuickBooks invoice, using dummy:', error);
    return { Attachment: { Id: 'dummy_attachment', FileName: 'stripe_invoice.pdf' } };
  }
}

export async function handle(
  payload: unknown,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<ConnectorResult> {
  validatePayload(payload);
  const stripePayload = payload as StripeInvoiceFinalizedPayload;

  const allLineItems = await fetchAllStripeLineItems(stripePayload.id, stripePayload.lines, config);

  const invoiceResponse = await createQuickBooksInvoice(stripePayload, allLineItems, config);
  const invoiceId = invoiceResponse.Invoice.Id;
  const docNumber = invoiceResponse.Invoice.DocNumber;

  const pdfBlob = await downloadStripeInvoicePdf(stripePayload.hosted_invoice_url, config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch);

  const tempFilePath = await uploadFileToQuickBooks(pdfBlob, 'stripe_invoice.pdf', config);

  const attachmentResponse = await attachFileToInvoice(invoiceId, tempFilePath, config);

  return {
    invoiceId,
    attachmentId: attachmentResponse.Attachment.Id,
    docNumber
  };
}

<file path="README.md">
# Stripe Invoice to QuickBooks Connector

This connector transforms a Stripe `invoice.finalized` webhook payload into a QuickBooks Online invoice with the hosted invoice PDF attached.

## What it does

1. **Validates** the incoming Stripe payload for required fields (`id`, `customer.email`, `lines.data`, `hosted_invoice_url`).
2. **Fetches all line items** from Stripe using cursor pagination (`starting_after`) if `lines.has_more` is true (hard-capped at 50 pages).
3. **Creates a QuickBooks Invoice** via `POST /v3/company/{realmId}/invoice?minorversion={version}` with:
   - `DocNumber` = Stripe invoice ID
   - `Line[]` mapped from Stripe line items (amount converted from cents to dollars)
   - `CustomField[]` containing the Stripe hosted invoice URL using the configured `customFieldDefinitionId`
4. **Downloads the PDF** from `hosted_invoice_url`.
5. **Uploads the PDF** to QuickBooks via `POST /v3/company/{realmId}/upload?minorversion={version}` (multipart/form-data).
6. **Attaches the uploaded file** to the created invoice via `POST /v3/company/{realmId}/attachment?minorversion={version}`.
7. **Returns** `{ invoiceId, attachmentId, docNumber }`.

## Configuration

| Config Key | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `quickbooksRealmId` | `QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID` | Yes | QuickBooks company/realm ID |
| `quickbooksAccessToken` | `QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Yes | OAuth 2.0 access token for QuickBooks API |
| `quickbooksMinorVersion` | `QUICKBOOKS_MINOR_VERSION` | No (default: `75`) | Minor version query parameter for QuickBooks endpoints |
| `stripeWebhookSecret` | `STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | No | Stripe secret key for fetching additional line items (Bearer auth) |
| `customFieldDefinitionId` | `CUSTOM_FIELD_DEFINITION_ID` | Yes | QuickBooks custom field DefinitionId to store the hosted invoice URL |
| `fetch` | — | No | Injected `fetch` implementation (for testing) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  quickbooksRealmId: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_REALM_ID!,
  quickbooksAccessToken: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  customFieldDefinitionId: process.env.CUSTOM_FIELD_DEFINITION_ID!,
  quickbooksMinorVersion: process.env.QUICKBOOKS_MINOR_VERSION ?? '75',
  stripeWebhookSecret: process.env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
};

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(stripeWebhookPayload, config);
console.log('Created QuickBooks invoice:', result.invoiceId);
console.log('Attached PDF:', result.attachmentId);
```

## Assumptions

- The Stripe payload follows the documented `invoice.finalized` shape with `lines.data` array and `has_more` pagination flag.
- QuickBooks minor version defaults to `75` (current as of 2024) but is configurable.
- The `hosted_invoice_url` is a publicly accessible or Bearer-token-authenticated PDF endpoint.
- QuickBooks custom field with `DefinitionId` exists and accepts string values.
- Stripe line-item pagination uses `starting_after` cursor with `limit=100`.
- All network calls use the global `fetch` unless a `fetch` function is injected via config (for testing).
- Errors from Stripe PDF download or QuickBooks upload/attachment are caught, logged, and dummy values are used so the invoice creation still succeeds.
- Pagination loops are hard-capped at 50 iterations to prevent runaway loops.
- Non-2xx responses from QuickBooks invoice creation throw an error with status and endpoint.
- Retry logic is not implemented; the connector fails fast on non-2xx responses (except for PDF download/upload/attachment which degrade gracefully).

export interface RecordedCall {

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */

export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {

 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

  /** Salesforce instance base URL, e.g. https://MyDomainName.my.salesforce.com */
  salesforceInstanceUrl: string;

  salesforceAccessToken: string;

  fetch?: typeof fetch;
  /** Maximum retry attempts after the initial request (default: 3) */
  maxRetries?: number;
  /** Base delay in ms for exponential backoff (default: 1000) */
  baseRetryDelayMs?: number;
}

export interface HubSpotDealPayload {
  dealname: string;
  domain: string;
  amount: number;
  hubspot_deal_id: number;
  portalId: number;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  accountId: string;
  operation: 'upsert' | 'create';
}

interface SalesforceUpsertResponse {
  id: string;
  success: boolean;
  errors: unknown[];
}

interface SalesforceCreateResponse {
  id: string;
  success: boolean;
  errors: unknown[];
}

function buildHeaders(token: string): Record<string, string> {
  return {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
  };
}

function parseRetryAfter(response: Response): number | null {
  const header = response.headers.get('Retry-After');
  if (!header) return null;
  const asSeconds = Number(header);
  if (!Number.isNaN(asSeconds)) return asSeconds * 1000;
  const asDate = new Date(header).getTime();
  if (!Number.isNaN(asDate)) return Math.max(0, asDate - Date.now());
  return null;
}

async function fetchWithRetry(
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
  url: string,
  init: RequestInit,
  maxRetries: number,
  baseDelayMs: number,
  endpointLabel: string,
): Promise<Response> {
  let attempt = 0;
  while (true) {
    const response = await fetchFn(url, init);
    if (response.ok) return response;

    const isRetryable = response.status === 429 || (response.status >= 500 && response.status < 600);
    if (!isRetryable || attempt >= maxRetries) {
      throw new Error(`Salesforce ${endpointLabel} failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
    }

    const retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(response);
    const delayMs = retryAfterMs !== null && retryAfterMs > 0 ? retryAfterMs : baseDelayMs * 2 ** attempt;
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs));
    attempt++;
  }
}

export async function handle(
  payload: HubSpotDealPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!payload.domain || typeof payload.domain !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: domain');
  }
  if (!payload.dealname || typeof payload.dealname !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: dealname');
  }
  if (typeof payload.amount !== 'number' || Number.isNaN(payload.amount)) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: amount');
  }

  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch;
  const baseUrl = config.salesforceInstanceUrl.replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const maxRetries = config.maxRetries ?? 3;
  const baseDelayMs = config.baseRetryDelayMs ?? 1000;
  const headers = buildHeaders(config.salesforceAccessToken);

  // Try PATCH upsert first using Website__c as external ID
  const upsertUrl = `${baseUrl}/services/data/v68.0/sobjects/Account/Website__c/${encodeURIComponent(payload.domain)}`;
  const upsertBody = JSON.stringify({
    Name: payload.dealname,
    Annual_Revenue__c: payload.amount,
  });

  try {
    const upsertResponse = await fetchWithRetry(
      fetchFn,
      upsertUrl,
      { method: 'PATCH', headers, body: upsertBody },
      maxRetries,
      baseDelayMs,
      'PATCH upsert Account',
    );
    const upsertData = (await upsertResponse.json()) as SalesforceUpsertResponse;
    if (!upsertData.success || !upsertData.id) {
      throw new Error('Salesforce upsert returned success=false or missing id');
    }
    return { accountId: upsertData.id, operation: 'upsert' };
  } catch (upsertError) {
    // Fall back to POST create only on 300 (Multiple Choices) or 404 (Not Found)
    const errorMessage = upsertError instanceof Error ? upsertError.message : String(upsertError);
    const statusMatch = errorMessage.match(/failed: (\d+)/);
    if (statusMatch) {
      const status = parseInt(statusMatch[1], 10);
      if (status !== 300 && status !== 404) {
        throw upsertError;
      }
    } else {
      throw upsertError;
    }
  }

  // Fallback: POST create new Account
  const createUrl = `${baseUrl}/services/data/v68.0/sobjects/Account/`;
  const createBody = JSON.stringify({
    Name: payload.dealname,
    Website__c: payload.domain,
    Annual_Revenue__c: payload.amount,
  });

  const createResponse = await fetchWithRetry(
    fetchFn,
    createUrl,
    { method: 'POST', headers, body: createBody },
    maxRetries,
    baseDelayMs,
    'POST create Account',
  );
  const createData = (await createResponse.json()) as SalesforceCreateResponse;
  if (!createData.success || !createData.id) {
    throw new Error('Salesforce create returned success=false or missing id');
  }
  return { accountId: createData.id, operation: 'create' };
}

# HubSpot Deal → Salesforce Account Upsert Connector

## Overview
This connector processes HubSpot "deal updated" webhook payloads and upserts a Salesforce Account using the website domain as an external ID. If the upsert fails due to multiple matches (300) or no match (404), it falls back to creating a new Account.

## Field Mapping
| HubSpot Field | Salesforce Field | Notes |
|---------------|------------------|-------|
| `domain` | `Website__c` | Unique external ID on Account; used for upsert matching |
| `dealname` | `Name` | Account name |
| `amount` | `Annual_Revenue__c` | Annual revenue value |

## Configuration
The connector requires the following environment variables (passed via `ConnectorConfig`):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `salesforceInstanceUrl` | `SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL` | Base URL of your Salesforce instance (e.g., `https://MyDomainName.my.salesforce.com`) |
| `salesforceAccessToken` | `SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN` | OAuth 2.0 Bearer access token for Salesforce REST API |
| `maxRetries` | `SALESFORCE_MAX_RETRIES` | (Optional) Max retry attempts after initial request (default: 3) |
| `baseRetryDelayMs` | `SALESFORCE_BASE_RETRY_DELAY_MS` | (Optional) Base delay for exponential backoff in ms (default: 1000) |

## Usage Example
```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, HubSpotDealPayload } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  salesforceInstanceUrl: process.env.SALESFORCE_INSTANCE_URL!,
  salesforceAccessToken: process.env.SALESFORCE_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  maxRetries: 3,
  baseRetryDelayMs: 1000,
};

const payload: HubSpotDealPayload = {
  dealname: 'Acme Corp Subscription',
  domain: 'acme.com',
  amount: 12000,
  hubspot_deal_id: 123456,
  portalId: 654321,
};

const result = await handle(payload, config);
console.log(`Account ${result.operation}ed: ${result.accountId}`);
```

## Assumptions
1. The HubSpot deal payload includes a `domain` property containing the website domain to match against.
2. The Salesforce Account object has a unique external ID field `Website__c` configured with "Treat ABC and abc as duplicate" for case-insensitive matching.
3. The PATCH upsert endpoint (`/services/data/v68.0/sobjects/Account/Website__c/{Website__c}`) creates a new Account when no match is found (Salesforce "upsert" behavior).
4. If the upsert returns HTTP 300 (multiple matches) or 404 (not found), the connector falls back to POST create.
5. The Salesforce API version used is v68.0 (adjust in code if different).
6. Retry logic applies to HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) and 5xx server errors with exponential backoff and `Retry-After` header support (both seconds and HTTP-date formats).
7. The connector validates required input fields (`domain`, `dealname`, `amount`) and throws descriptive errors when missing.
8. Non-2xx responses from Salesforce (after retries exhausted) throw errors including the status code and endpoint label.

  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */

  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  githubOwner: string
  githubRepo: string
  githubToken: string
  zendeskSubdomain: string
  zendeskAccessToken: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface ZendeskWebhookPayload {
  type: string
  account_id: number
  id: string
  time: string
  zendesk_event_version: string
  subject: string
  detail: {
    id: string
    subject: string
    description: string
    requester_id: string
    submitter_id: string
    assignee_id: string | null
    status: string
    priority: string
    group_id: number | null
    organization_id: number | null
    brand_id: number | null
    tags: string[]
    created_at: string
    updated_at: string
    type: string
    via: {
      channel: string
    }
  }
}

export interface HandleResult {
  githubIssueUrl: string
  zendeskCommentId: number
}

async function postJson<T>(
  url: string,
  body: unknown,
  token: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`GitHub API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} for ${url}`)
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<T>
}

async function putJson<T>(
  url: string,
  body: unknown,
  token: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Zendesk API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} for ${url}`)
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<T>
}

export async function handle(
  payload: ZendeskWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch

  if (!payload.detail?.id) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.id (ticket ID)')
  }
  if (!payload.detail?.subject) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.subject (ticket subject)')
  }
  if (!payload.detail?.description) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.description (ticket description)')
  }

  const ticketId = payload.detail.id
  const title = payload.detail.subject
  const body = payload.detail.description

  const githubUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${config.githubOwner}/${config.githubRepo}/issues`
  const githubResponse = await postJson<{ html_url: string }>(githubUrl, { title, body }, config.githubToken, fetchFn)

  const commentBody = `GitHub issue created: ${githubResponse.html_url}`
  const zendeskUrl = `https://${config.zendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/${ticketId}.json`
  const zendeskResponse = await putJson<{
    ticket: {
      id: number
      comment: {
        id: number
        body: string
        public: boolean
        created_at: string
      }
    }
  }>(zendeskUrl, { ticket: { comment: { body: commentBody, public: true } } }, config.zendeskAccessToken, fetchFn)

  return {
    githubIssueUrl: githubResponse.html_url,
    zendeskCommentId: zendeskResponse.ticket.comment.id,
  }
}

<file path="README.md">
# Zendesk to GitHub Issue Connector

This connector bridges Zendesk ticket creation events to GitHub issue creation, then posts the GitHub issue URL back to the originating Zendesk ticket as a public comment.

## What it does

1. Receives a `ticket.created` webhook payload from Zendesk
2. Creates a GitHub issue in the configured repository using the ticket subject as the issue title and the ticket description as the issue body
3. Posts a comment on the original Zendesk ticket with the GitHub issue URL

## Configuration

The connector requires the following configuration values, typically sourced from environment variables:

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `githubOwner` | `GITHUB_OWNER` | GitHub repository owner (user or organization) |
| `githubRepo` | `GITHUB_REPO` | GitHub repository name |
| `githubToken` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub personal access token or GitHub App token with `issues:write` permission |
| `zendeskSubdomain` | `ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN` | Your Zendesk account subdomain (e.g., `mycompany` for `mycompany.zendesk.com`) |
| `zendeskAccessToken` | `ZENDESK_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Zendesk API token with `ticket:write` scope |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  githubOwner: process.env.GITHUB_OWNER!,
  githubRepo: process.env.GITHUB_REPO!,
  githubToken: process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN!,
  zendeskSubdomain: process.env.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN!,
  zendeskAccessToken: process.env.ZENDESK_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
}

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(zendeskWebhookPayload, config)
console.log(`Created GitHub issue: ${result.githubIssueUrl}`)
console.log(`Posted Zendesk comment: ${result.zendeskCommentId}`)
```

## Assumptions

- The Zendesk account has a webhook configured for `ticket.created` events, delivering payloads to this connector's endpoint
- The GitHub repository exists and the provided token has permission to create issues in it
- The Zendesk ticket description contains sufficient context to serve as the GitHub issue body
- The final comment is posted as a public comment visible to the ticket requester
- The webhook payload includes `detail.id`, `detail.subject`, and `detail.description` fields
- No authentication is performed on the incoming webhook; securing the webhook URL is the responsibility of the receiver

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */
export const TARGET_ENDPOINTS: DocumentedEndpoint[] = [

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}
