export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** Shopify client secret for HMAC-SHA256 verification (env: SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET) */
  shopifyClientSecret: string
  /** Airtable API key for Bearer authentication (env: AIRTABLE_API_KEY) */
  airtableApiKey: string
  /** Airtable base ID (e.g., appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX) */
  airtableBaseId: string
  /** Airtable table name or ID */
  airtableTableNameOrId: string
  /** Deduplication store for order_id + hmac pairs */
  dedupStore: DedupStore
  /** Injected fetch for testing (defaults to global fetch) */
  fetch?: typeof fetch
  /** Maximum retry attempts after initial request (default: 3) */
  maxRetries?: number
  /** Base retry delay in ms (default: 1000) */
  baseRetryDelayMs?: number
  /** Optional HMAC verification function (defaults to Web Crypto API) */
  verifyHmac?: (rawBody: string, hmacHeader: string, secret: string) => Promise<boolean>
}

export interface DedupStore {
  /** Check if a deduplication key has been seen */
  has(key: string): Promise<boolean>
  /** Record a deduplication key as seen */
  add(key: string): Promise<void>
}

/** Shopify orders/paid webhook payload (UCP format) */
export interface ShopifyOrderPaidPayload {
  id: string
  label: string
  currency: string
  totals: Array<{ type: string; display_text: string; amount: number }>
  line_items: unknown[]
  fulfillment: unknown
  adjustments?: unknown[]
  ucp: unknown
  /** Raw request body for HMAC verification (added by webhook handler) */
  _rawBody?: string
  /** Request headers for HMAC and webhook ID (added by webhook handler) */
  _headers?: Record<string, string>
}

export interface HandleResult {
  /** Airtable record IDs returned by upsert */
  airtableRecordIds: string[]
  /** True if at least one record was created */
  created: boolean
  /** True if at least one record was updated */
  updated: boolean
  /** True if the webhook was deduplicated and not processed */
  deduplicated: boolean
}

interface AirtableUpsertResponse {
  records: Array<{ id: string; createdTime: string; fields: Record<string, unknown> }>
  updatedRecords: string[][]
  createdRecords: string[]
}

function findTotalAmount(payload: ShopifyOrderPaidPayload, type: string): number | null {
  const total = payload.totals.find(t => t.type === type)
  return total ? total.amount : null
}

function extractCustomerEmail(payload: ShopifyOrderPaidPayload): string {
  const fulfillment = payload.fulfillment as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
  const expectations = fulfillment?.expectations as unknown[] | undefined
  if (expectations?.[0]) {
    const dest = (expectations[0] as Record<string, unknown>).destination as Record<string, unknown> | undefined
    if (dest?.email) return String(dest.email)
  }
  return ''
}

async function defaultVerifyHmac(rawBody: string, hmacHeader: string, secret: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const crypto = globalThis.crypto
  if (!crypto?.subtle) {
    throw new Error('Web Crypto API (crypto.subtle) not available; provide verifyHmac in config')
  }
  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  const keyData = encoder.encode(secret)
  const messageData = encoder.encode(rawBody)
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', keyData, { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign'])
  const signature = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, messageData)
  const signatureHex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature))
    .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('')
  return signatureHex === hmacHeader.toLowerCase()
}

function parseRetryAfter(header: string | null): number | null {
  if (!header) return null
  const seconds = parseInt(header, 10)
  if (!isNaN(seconds)) return seconds * 1000
  const date = new Date(header)
  if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    const diff = date.getTime() - Date.now()
    return diff > 0 ? diff : null
  }
  return null
}

function isRetryableStatus(status: number): boolean {
  return status === 429 || status >= 500
}

export async function handle(
  payload: ShopifyOrderPaidPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  // Validate required fields
  if (!payload.id) throw new Error('Missing required field: id')
  if (!payload.label) throw new Error('Missing required field: label')
  if (!payload.currency) throw new Error('Missing required field: currency')
  if (!payload.totals || !Array.isArray(payload.totals)) throw new Error('Missing required field: totals')

  const orderId = payload.id
  const orderNumber = payload.label
  const currency = payload.currency

  const totalAmountCents = findTotalAmount(payload, 'total')
  if (totalAmountCents === null) throw new Error('Missing total amount in totals')
  const totalAmount = (totalAmountCents / 100).toFixed(2)

  const customerEmail = extractCustomerEmail(payload)

  const headers = payload._headers ?? {}
  const hmacHeader = headers['x-shopify-hmac-sha256'] ?? headers['X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256'] ?? ''
  const webhookId = headers['x-shopify-webhook-id'] ?? headers['X-Shopify-Webhook-Id'] ?? ''

  // HMAC verification
  let hmacVerified = false
  const verifyHmac = config.verifyHmac ?? defaultVerifyHmac
  if (payload._rawBody && hmacHeader) {
    hmacVerified = await verifyHmac(payload._rawBody, hmacHeader, config.shopifyClientSecret)
    if (!hmacVerified) throw new Error('HMAC verification failed')
  }

  // Deduplication key: orderId + hmac (fallback to webhookId, then orderId alone)
  const dedupKey = hmacHeader ? `${orderId}:${hmacHeader}` : webhookId ? `${orderId}:${webhookId}` : orderId

  const isDuplicate = await config.dedupStore.has(dedupKey)
  if (isDuplicate) {
    return { airtableRecordIds: [], created: false, updated: false, deduplicated: true }
  }

  // Map fields for Airtable upsert
  const fields = {
    'Order Number': orderNumber,
    'Customer Email': customerEmail,
    'Total': totalAmount,
    'HMAC Digest': hmacHeader,
    'Dedup Order ID': orderId
  }

  const url = `https://api.airtable.com/v0/${config.airtableBaseId}/${config.airtableTableNameOrId}`
  const body = {
    performUpsert: { fieldsToMergeOn: ['Order Number'] },
    records: [{ fields }]
  }

  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const maxRetries = config.maxRetries ?? 3
  const baseRetryDelayMs = config.baseRetryDelayMs ?? 1000

  let attempt = 0
  while (true) {
    try {
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: 'PATCH',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.airtableApiKey}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json'
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      })

      if (response.status >= 200 && response.status < 300) {
        const data = await response.json() as AirtableUpsertResponse
        await config.dedupStore.add(dedupKey)

        const recordIds = data.records?.map(r => r.id) ?? []
        const updated = data.updatedRecords?.flat() ?? []
        const created = data.createdRecords ?? []

        return {
          airtableRecordIds: recordIds,
          created: created.length > 0,
          updated: updated.length > 0,
          deduplicated: false
        }
      }

      const errorText = await response.text()
      const retryable = isRetryableStatus(response.status)
      if (!retryable || attempt >= maxRetries) {
        throw new Error(`Airtable upsert failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} - ${errorText}`)
      }

      const retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfter(response.headers.get('Retry-After'))
      const exponentialMs = baseRetryDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt)
      const delayMs = retryAfterMs !== null ? Math.max(retryAfterMs, exponentialMs) : exponentialMs
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs))
      attempt++
    } catch (error) {
      // If it's a non-retryable error we threw above, re-throw
      if (error instanceof Error && error.message.startsWith('Airtable upsert failed:')) {
        throw error
      }
      // Network error or other - retry if attempts remain
      if (attempt >= maxRetries) {
        throw new Error('Airtable upsert failed after retries')
      }
      const exponentialMs = baseRetryDelayMs * Math.pow(2, attempt)
      await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, exponentialMs))
      attempt++
    }
  }
}

# Shopify Orders/Paid → Airtable Upsert Connector

This connector receives Shopify `orders/paid` webhook payloads (UCP format), verifies the HMAC-SHA256 signature, deduplicates using a provided store, maps fields, and upserts into an Airtable base via the **PATCH /v0/{baseId}/{tableNameOrId}** endpoint with `performUpsert`.

## What it does

1. **Validates** required fields: `id`, `label`, `currency`, `totals[]`
2. **Verifies HMAC-SHA256** using the `X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256` header and raw request body against `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET`
3. **Deduplicates** using a composite key: `orderId:hmac` (fallback `orderId:webhookId`, then `orderId` alone) via a provided `DedupStore`
4. **Maps fields** for Airtable upsert:
   - `Order Number` ← `label` (e.g., `#1042`)
   - `Customer Email` ← `fulfillment.expectations[0].destination.email`
   - `Total` ← `totals[type=total].amount / 100` formatted to 2 decimals
   - `HMAC Digest` ← `X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256` header
   - `Dedup Order ID` ← `id`
5. **Upserts** via `PATCH https://api.airtable.com/v0/{baseId}/{tableNameOrId}` with `performUpsert: { fieldsToMergeOn: ['Order Number'] }`
4. **Retries** on 429 / 5xx with exponential backoff + `Retry-After` header (max 3 retries by default)
5. **Records dedup key** on success, returns `{ airtableRecordIds, created, updated, deduplicated }`

## Configuration

| Config Property | Env Var | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `shopifyClientSecret` | `SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET` | Yes | HMAC-SHA256 secret from Shopify app |
| `airtableApiKey` | `AIRTABLE_API_KEY` | Yes | Airtable Personal Access Token (`pat_...`) |
| `airtableBaseId` | `AIRTABLE_BASE_ID` | Yes | Airtable base ID (e.g., `appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX`) |
| `airtableTableNameOrId` | `AIRTABLE_TABLE_NAME_OR_ID` | Yes | Table name or ID (e.g., `tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX` or `Orders`) |
| `dedupStore` | — | Yes | Object with `has(key)` and `add(key)` async methods |
| `fetch` | — | No | Injected `fetch` (defaults to global `fetch`) |
| `maxRetries` | — | No | Max retry attempts after initial request (default: 3) |
| `baseRetryDelayMs` | — | No | Base delay for exponential backoff in ms (default: 1000) |
| `verifyHmac` | — | No | Custom HMAC verifier `(rawBody, hmacHeader, secret) => Promise<boolean>` |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, ShopifyOrderPaidPayload, DedupStore } from './connector'

// In-memory dedup store for demo; use Redis/DB in production
const dedupStore: DedupStore = {
  has: async (key) => store.has(key),
  add: async (key) => store.add(key)
}

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  shopifyClientSecret: process.env.SHOPIFY_CLIENT_SECRET!,
  airtableApiKey: process.env.AIRTABLE_API_KEY!,
  airtableBaseId: process.env.AIRTABLE_BASE_ID!,
  airtableTableNameOrId: process.env.AIRTABLE_TABLE_NAME_OR_ID!,
  dedupStore,
  maxRetries: 3,
  baseRetryDelayMs: 1000
}

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Hono, Express, Cloudflare Workers):
app.post('/shopify/orders-paid', async (c) => {
  const rawBody = await c.req.text()
  const headers = Object.fromEntries(c.req.headers.entries())
  const payload = JSON.parse(rawBody) as ShopifyOrderPaidPayload
  payload._rawBody = rawBody
  payload._headers = headers

  const result = await handle(payload, config)
  return c.json(result)
})
```

## Assumptions

- **Shopify webhook** sends `orders/paid` in UCP format with `X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256` and `X-Shopify-Webhook-Id` headers.
- **Raw body** and **headers** are attached to the payload as `_rawBody` and `_headers` by the webhook framework.
- **Airtable base/table** already has fields: `Order Number` (single line text, unique), `Customer Email` (email), `Total` (currency/number), `HMAC Digest` (long text), `Dedup Order ID` (single line text).
- **Deduplication store** is provided by the host (Redis, KV store, in-memory for dev). The connector only calls `has(key)` and `add(key)`.
- **HMAC verification** uses the Web Crypto API (`crypto.subtle`) by default; provide `verifyHmac` in config for environments without it (e.g., Node < 19, edge runtimes).
- **Retry policy**: up to `maxRetries` attempts after the initial request (default 3). Retryable statuses: `429`, `5xx`. Delay = `max(Retry-After, baseMs * 2^attempt)` where `attempt` starts at 0. `Retry-After` may be seconds or HTTP-date.
- **Airtable upsert** uses `PATCH /v0/{baseId}/{tableNameOrId}` with `performUpsert: { fieldsToMergeOn: ['Order Number'] }`. Response shape: `{ records[], updatedRecords[][], createdRecords[] }`.
- **Deduplication key** priority: `orderId:hmac` > `orderId:webhookId` > `orderId`.
- **Total amount** sourced from `totals[type='total'].amount` (cents → dollars with 2 decimals).
- **Customer email** sourced from `fulfillment.expectations[0].destination.email` (empty string if absent).
- **HMAC header** read case-insensitively as `x-shopify-hmac-sha256` or `X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256`.
- **Webhook ID header** read case-insensitively as `x-shopify-webhook-id` or `X-Shopify-Webhook-Id`.
- **No network calls in tests** — all tests use injected fake `fetch`.
- **TypeScript strict mode** — all types explicit, no `any`.

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string

          }
        }
      ],

        ]
      ],

    }

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  intercomAccessToken: string
  zendeskApiToken: string
  zendeskSubdomain: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

  topic: string
  data: {
    item: {
      type: string

        id: string

      }>
    }
  }

export interface IntercomConversation {
  type: string
  id: string
  url: string
  subject: string
}

export interface ZendeskTicketRequest {
  ticket: {
    subject: string
    comment: {
      body: string
    }
  }
}

export interface ZendeskTicketResponse {
  ticket: {

  }
}

  conversationId: string

  ticketUrl: string

async function fetchConversation(
  conversationId: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<IntercomConversation> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const url = `https://api.intercom.io/conversations/${conversationId}`
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.intercomAccessToken}`,
      Accept: 'application/json',
    },
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Intercom GET ${url} failed with ${response.status}`)
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<IntercomConversation>
}

  }

  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.zendeskApiToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Zendesk POST ${url} failed with ${response.status}`)
  }

  return response.json() as Promise<ZendeskTicketResponse>
}

export async function handle(
  payload: IntercomWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!payload.topic) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: topic')
  }
  if (payload.topic !== 'conversation.tag.created') {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported topic: ${payload.topic}`)
  }

  if (!payload.data?.item) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item')
  }

  const { id: conversationId, conversation_tags } = payload.data.item

  if (!conversationId) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item.id')
  }

  if (!Array.isArray(conversation_tags) || conversation_tags.length === 0) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item.conversation_tags')
  }

  const refundTag = conversation_tags.find((tag) => tag.name === 'refund')
  if (!refundTag) {
    throw new Error('Conversation does not have the "refund" tag')
  }

  const conversation = await fetchConversation(conversationId, config)

  const subject = conversation.subject || `Intercom Conversation ${conversation.id}`
  const description = `View the conversation: ${conversation.url}`

  const ticketResponse = await createZendeskTicket(subject, description, config)

  // Construct the ticket URL using the known Zendesk pattern and actual subdomain
  // rather than relying on the API response which may have placeholders in documentation
  const ticketUrl = `https://${config.zendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/${ticketResponse.ticket.id}.json`

  return {
    conversationId: conversation.id,
    ticketId: ticketResponse.ticket.id,
    ticketUrl,
  }
}

<file path="README.md">
# Intercom Refund Tag to Zendesk Ticket Connector

This connector listens for Intercom webhook events when a conversation receives the "refund" tag, fetches the full conversation details, and creates a Zendesk ticket with a link to the conversation.

## What it does

1. Receives an Intercom webhook payload (`conversation.tag.created` topic)
2. Validates the payload contains a conversation with the "refund" tag
3. Calls the Intercom API to retrieve the full conversation (URL and subject)
4. Creates a Zendesk ticket with:
   - Subject: Conversation subject (or fallback "Intercom Conversation {id}")
   - Description: "View the conversation: {conversation_url}"

## Configuration

The connector requires the following environment variables (passed via `ConnectorConfig`):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `intercomAccessToken` | `INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Bearer token for Intercom API (conversation read access) |
| `zendeskApiToken` | `ZENDESK_API_TOKEN` | Bearer token for Zendesk API (ticket create permission) |
| `zendeskSubdomain` | `ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN` | Your Zendesk subdomain (e.g., `mycompany` for `mycompany.zendesk.com`) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  intercomAccessToken: process.env.INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  zendeskApiToken: process.env.ZENDESK_API_TOKEN!,
  zendeskSubdomain: process.env.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN!,
}

// In your webhook handler:
app.post('/intercom/webhook', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const result = await handle(req.body, config)
    res.json({ success: true, ticketId: result.ticketId, ticketUrl: result.ticketUrl })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err)
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Assumptions

- The Intercom webhook payload includes a `conversation` object with `id`, `url`, and `subject` fields (retrieved via the Intercom API call).
- The Zendesk integration uses an API token with permission to create tickets.
- The ticket subject will be populated from the conversation subject or a default derived from the conversation ID.
- Only the `conversation.tag.created` topic with tag name `refund` triggers the workflow.
- The Intercom API endpoint `GET /conversations/{id}` returns the conversation with `url` and `subject` fields.
- The Zendesk API expects the ticket description in `ticket.comment.body`.

## Field Mapping

| Source Field | Target Field | Notes |
|--------------|--------------|-------|
| `conversation.id` | `ticket.subject` (prefix/fallback) | Used as fallback when subject is empty |
| `conversation.url` | `ticket.comment.body` | Embedded as "View the conversation: {url}" |
| `conversation.subject` | `ticket.subject` | Primary subject source |

## Error Handling

The connector throws descriptive errors for:
- Missing required fields in the webhook payload
- Unsupported webhook topics
- Missing "refund" tag on the conversation
- Non-2xx responses from Intercom or Zendesk APIs (includes status code and endpoint)

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */
export const TARGET_ENDPOINTS: DocumentedEndpoint[] = [

]

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  stripeSecretKey: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface HubSpotWebhookPayload {
  properties: Array<{
    name: string
    value: string
  }>
}

export interface StripeCustomerResponse {
  id: string
  object: string
  email: string
  name: string
  created: number
  livemode: boolean
}

export interface HandleResult {
  stripeCustomerId: string
}

function extractProperty(payload: HubSpotWebhookPayload, name: string): string | undefined {
  const prop = payload.properties.find((p) => p.name === name)
  return prop?.value
}

export async function handle(payload: HubSpotWebhookPayload, config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch

  const email = extractProperty(payload, 'email')
  const firstname = extractProperty(payload, 'firstname')
  const lastname = extractProperty(payload, 'lastname')

  if (!email) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: email')
  }
  if (!firstname) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: firstname')
  }
  if (!lastname) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: lastname')
  }

  const fullName = `${firstname} ${lastname}`.trim()

  const requestBody = JSON.stringify({
    email,
    name: fullName,
  })

  const response = await fetchImpl('https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.stripeSecretKey}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: requestBody,
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Stripe API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST https://api.stripe.com/v1/customers`)
  }

  const customer = (await response.json()) as StripeCustomerResponse

  return {
    stripeCustomerId: customer.id,
  }
}

# HubSpot to Stripe Customer Connector

Creates a Stripe customer record when a HubSpot contact is marked as a customer.

## What it does

Listens for HubSpot contact property change webhooks. When a contact's `customer_status` property changes (indicating they've become a customer), extracts the contact's email, first name, and last name from the webhook payload and creates a corresponding Stripe customer.

## Configuration

| Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `STRIPE_SECRET_KEY` | Yes | Stripe secret API key with permission to create customers (starts with `sk_`) |

The connector accepts a `ConnectorConfig` object with:
- `stripeSecretKey` (string): Your Stripe secret key
- `fetch` (optional): Custom fetch implementation for testing

## Usage

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, HubSpotWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  stripeSecretKey: process.env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY!,
}

const payload: HubSpotWebhookPayload = {
  properties: [
    { name: 'email', value: 'jane.doe@example.com' },
    { name: 'firstname', value: 'Jane' },
    { name: 'lastname', value: 'Doe' },
  ],
}

const result = await handle(payload, config)
console.log(`Created Stripe customer: ${result.stripeCustomerId}`)
```

## Field Mapping

| HubSpot Property | Stripe Field | Transformation |
|-----------------|--------------|----------------|
| `email` | `email` | Direct copy |
| `firstname` + `lastname` | `name` | Combined as `"${firstname} ${lastname}"` |

## Assumptions

1. The HubSpot contact has a `customer_status` property that changes to `true` when they become a customer (this triggers the webhook).
2. The contact has valid `email`, `firstname`, and `lastname` properties populated.
3. The Stripe API key has permissions to create customers (`customers.write` scope).
4. HubSpot webhook delivers contact property changes as an array of objects under `properties`, each with `name` and `value` fields.
5. Stripe requires `email` (max 512 chars) and `name` (max 256 chars) for customer creation.

## Error Handling

- Throws descriptive errors when required fields (`email`, `firstname`, `lastname`) are missing from the webhook payload.
- Throws on non-2xx Stripe API responses with status code and endpoint included in the error message.
- Extra properties in the webhook payload are ignored gracefully.

export function fakeFetch(

): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {

    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** Slack bot token with chat:write scope */
  slackBotToken: string
  /** Slack channel ID or name (e.g., C12345 or #general) */
  slackChannel: string
  /** Optional injected fetch for testing */
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface CalendlyInviteeCreatedPayload {
  event: 'invitee.created'
  payload: {
    invitee: {
      name: string
      email: string
    }
    answers: Record<string, string>
    uri: string
  }
}

export interface SlackPostMessageResponse {
  ok: boolean
  channel: string
  ts: string
}

export interface HandleResult {
  slackMessage: SlackPostMessageResponse
}

function validatePayload(payload: unknown): asserts payload is CalendlyInviteeCreatedPayload {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Payload must be an object')
  }
  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (p.event !== 'invitee.created') {
    throw new Error(`Expected event "invitee.created", got "${p.event}"`)
  }
  if (!p.payload || typeof p.payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Missing payload object')
  }
  const pl = p.payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (!pl.invitee || typeof pl.invitee !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Missing invitee object')
  }
  const invitee = pl.invitee as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof invitee.name !== 'string' || !invitee.name.trim()) {
    throw new Error('Missing or empty invitee.name')
  }
  if (typeof invitee.email !== 'string' || !invitee.email.trim()) {
    throw new Error('Missing or empty invitee.email')
  }
  if (!pl.answers || typeof pl.answers !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Missing answers object')
  }
}

function formatAnswers(answers: Record<string, string>): string {
  const entries = Object.entries(answers)
  if (entries.length === 0) return '{}'
  return JSON.stringify(answers, null, 2)
}

function buildSlackText(payload: CalendlyInviteeCreatedPayload): string {
  const { name, email } = payload.payload.invitee
  const answersText = formatAnswers(payload.payload.answers)
  return `New meeting booked!\nName: ${name}\nEmail: ${email}\nAnswers: ${answersText}`
}

export async function handle(
  payload: unknown,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  validatePayload(payload)
  const typedPayload = payload as CalendlyInviteeCreatedPayload

  const text = buildSlackText(typedPayload)
  const body = JSON.stringify({
    channel: config.slackChannel,
    text,
  })

  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const response = await fetchImpl('https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.slackBotToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body,
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack chat.postMessage failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`)
  }

  const result = await response.json() as SlackPostMessageResponse
  if (!result.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API error: ${JSON.stringify(result)}`)
  }

  return { slackMessage: result }
}

# Calendly to Slack Connector

Posts a message to a Slack channel when a Calendly meeting is booked via the `invitee.created` webhook.

## What it does

1. Receives a Calendly webhook payload (event: `invitee.created`)
2. Validates required fields: `invitee.name`, `invitee.email`, and `answers`
3. Formats a text message with the invitee's name, email, and their answers to custom questions
4. Posts the message to the configured Slack channel using `chat.postMessage`
5. Returns the Slack message timestamp (`ts`) and channel ID

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `slackBotToken` | `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Slack bot token with `chat:write` scope |
| `slackChannel` | `SLACK_CHANNEL` | Slack channel ID (e.g., `C01JASD6802`) or name (e.g., `#general`) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  slackBotToken: process.env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN!,
  slackChannel: process.env.SLACK_CHANNEL!,
}

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(webhookPayload, config)
console.log(`Posted to Slack: ${result.slackMessage.ts}`)
```

## Assumptions

- The Calendly webhook payload includes an `invitee` object with `name` and `email` fields
- Custom question answers are returned as a JSON object in the `answers` field of the payload
- The Slack integration posts a simple text message; formatting (blocks, buttons) can be added later if needed
- The webhook endpoint responds with 2xx status to avoid Calendly retries
- Slack bot token has the required `chat:write` OAuth scope

 */
export function fakeFetch(

): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {

  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {

  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  mailchimpApiKey: string;
  datadogApiKey: string;
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface MailchimpRequest {
  method: string;
  url: string;
  body?: unknown;
  headers?: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface MailchimpRateLimitPayload {
  originalRequest?: MailchimpRequest;
  retryAfterHeader?: string;
  errorContext?: string;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  success: boolean;
  retriesAttempted: number;
  finalStatus: 'success' | 'failed';
  datadogEventCreated: boolean;
}

async function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
}

function getRetryAfterSeconds(headers: Headers): number | null {
  const retryAfter = headers.get('retry-after');
  if (!retryAfter) return null;
  const seconds = parseInt(retryAfter, 10);
  return Number.isNaN(seconds) ? null : seconds;
}

async function makeMailchimpRequest(
  request: MailchimpRequest,
  apiKey: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
): Promise<{ response: Response; retryAfterSeconds: number | null }> {
  const baseUrl = 'https://us1.api.mailchimp.com/3.0';
  const url = request.url.startsWith('http')
    ? request.url
    : `${baseUrl}${request.url.startsWith('/') ? '' : '/'}${request.url}`;
  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
    Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
    'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    ...request.headers,
  };
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: request.method,
    headers,
    body: request.body ? JSON.stringify(request.body) : undefined,
  });
  const retryAfterSeconds = getRetryAfterSeconds(response.headers);
  return { response, retryAfterSeconds };
}

async function createDatadogEvent(
  title: string,
  text: string,
  apiKey: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
): Promise<Response> {
  const url = `https://api.datadoghq.com/api/v1/events?api_key=${encodeURIComponent(apiKey)}`;
  const body = JSON.stringify({
    title,
    text,
    priority: 'normal',
    source_type_name: 'Mailchimp',
    alert_type: 'info',
    tags: ['mailchimp', 'retry'],
  });
  return fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body,
  });
}

export async function handle(
  payload: MailchimpRateLimitPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch;

  if (!config.mailchimpApiKey) {
    throw new Error('Missing required config: mailchimpApiKey (env MAILCHIMP_API_KEY)');
  }
  if (!config.datadogApiKey) {
    throw new Error('Missing required config: datadogApiKey (env DD_API_KEY)');
  }

  let retriesAttempted = 0;
  let finalStatus: 'success' | 'failed' = 'failed';
  let lastRetryAfter: string | undefined = payload.retryAfterHeader;

  if (payload.originalRequest) {
    let attempt = 0;
    const maxRetries = 3;
    let response: Response | null = null;

    while (attempt <= maxRetries) {
      const { response: mailchimpResponse, retryAfterSeconds } = await makeMailchimpRequest(
        payload.originalRequest,
        config.mailchimpApiKey,
        fetchFn,
      );
      response = mailchimpResponse;

      if (mailchimpResponse.status === 429) {
        retriesAttempted = attempt + 1;
        if (retryAfterSeconds !== null) {
          lastRetryAfter = String(retryAfterSeconds);
          await sleep(retryAfterSeconds * 1000);
        } else {
          const backoffMs = Math.pow(2, attempt) * 1000;
          await sleep(backoffMs);
        }
        attempt++;
        continue;
      }

      if (mailchimpResponse.ok) {
        finalStatus = 'success';
      } else {
        finalStatus = 'failed';
      }
      break;
    }

    if (attempt > maxRetries && response?.status === 429) {
      finalStatus = 'failed';
    }
  } else {
    retriesAttempted = 0;
    finalStatus = 'failed';
  }

  const titleParts = ['Mailchimp API retry outcome'];
  if (retriesAttempted > 0) titleParts.push(`Retries: ${retriesAttempted}`);
  if (lastRetryAfter) titleParts.push(`Retry-After: ${lastRetryAfter}s`);
  const title = titleParts.join(' | ');

  const text = `Retry attempts: ${retriesAttempted}, Final status: ${finalStatus}${payload.errorContext ? `, Context: ${payload.errorContext}` : ''}`;

  let datadogEventCreated = false;
  try {
    const ddResponse = await createDatadogEvent(title, text, config.datadogApiKey, fetchFn);
    if (!ddResponse.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Datadog API error: ${ddResponse.status} ${ddResponse.statusText} at POST /api/v1/events`);
    }
    datadogEventCreated = true;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('Datadog API error')) throw error;
    throw new Error(`Failed to create Datadog event: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}`);
  }

  return {
    success: finalStatus === 'success',
    retriesAttempted,
    finalStatus,
    datadogEventCreated,
  };
}

# Mailchimp Rate Limit to Datadog Event Connector

## Overview

This connector handles Mailchimp Marketing API rate limit responses (HTTP 429 Too Many Requests) by implementing a retry mechanism with exponential backoff, then logs the final outcome to Datadog as an event.

When a Mailchimp API call returns 429, the connector:
1. Retries the original request up to 3 times (4 total attempts)
2. Uses exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) between retries
3. Respects the `Retry-After` header if present in the 429 response
4. Creates a Datadog event summarizing the retry attempts and final status

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `mailchimpApiKey` | `MAILCHIMP_API_KEY` | Yes | Mailchimp Marketing API key (used as Bearer token) |
| `datadogApiKey` | `DD_API_KEY` | Yes | Datadog API key for Events API (sent as `api_key` query parameter) |
| `fetch` | — | No | Optional fetch implementation for testing |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, MailchimpRateLimitPayload } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  mailchimpApiKey: process.env.MAILCHIMP_API_KEY!,
  datadogApiKey: process.env.DD_API_KEY!,
};

const payload: MailchimpRateLimitPayload = {
  originalRequest: {
    method: 'POST',
    url: '/campaigns',
    body: { name: 'Summer Sale', type: 'regular' },
  },
  errorContext: 'Campaign creation from webhook',
};

const result = await handle(payload, config);
console.log(result);
// { success: true, retriesAttempted: 1, finalStatus: 'success', datadogEventCreated: true }
```

## Assumptions

- The integration implements retry logic locally before making the final Datadog API call.
- Mailchimp's HTTP 429 response may include a `Retry-After` header indicating wait time in seconds; if absent, exponential backoff is used.
- The final outcome (success or failure) is captured after the retry loop completes.
- Datadog Events API requires an integration key (`api_key` query parameter), event title, and event text body.
- The connector is invoked with the original Mailchimp request details when a 429 is encountered.
- If no `originalRequest` is provided in the payload, a generic Datadog event is created indicating a 429 was encountered without a retryable request.

## Datadog Event Format

The created event includes:
- **title**: `Mailchimp API retry outcome | Retries: N | Retry-After: Xs` (parts omitted when not applicable)
- **text**: `Retry attempts: N, Final status: success|failed, Context: <errorContext>`
- **priority**: `normal`
- **source_type_name**: `Mailchimp`
- **alert_type**: `info`
- **tags**: `["mailchimp", "retry"]`

## Error Handling

- Throws descriptive errors when required config (`mailchimpApiKey`, `datadogApiKey`) is missing.
- Throws on non-2xx responses from Datadog Events API with status code and endpoint.
- Mailchimp non-429 errors (4xx, 5xx) are treated as final failures (no retry).

  event_type: string;
  form_response: {
    form_id: string;
    token: string;
    submitted_at: string;
    answers: Array<{
      type: string;
      email?: string;
      text?: string;
      field: {
        id: string;
        type: string;
      };
    }>;
  };
}

export interface HandleResult {
  contactId: number;
  listId: number;
}

function extractEmail(answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers']): string | undefined {
  const emailAnswer = answers.find((a) => a.type === 'email');
  return emailAnswer?.email;
}

function extractFirstName(answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers']): string | undefined {
  // In the documented example, the first text answer after email is first name
  // We'll take the first text answer as first name (assuming order)
  const textAnswers = answers.filter((a) => a.type === 'text');
  return textAnswers[0]?.text;
}

function extractLastName(answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers']): string | undefined {
  const textAnswers = answers.filter((a) => a.type === 'text');
  return textAnswers[1]?.text;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;

  if (!payload.form_response?.answers?.length) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: form_response.answers');
  }

  const email = extractEmail(payload.form_response.answers);
  if (!email) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: email (no answer with type "email")');
  }

  const firstName = extractFirstName(payload.form_response.answers);
  const lastName = extractLastName(payload.form_response.answers);

  // Step 1: Create contact in Brevo
  const createContactBody = {
    email,
    attributes: {
      FNAME: firstName ?? '',
      LNAME: lastName ?? '',
    },
    listIds: [config.listId],
  };

  const createResponse = await fetchImpl('https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'api-key': config.brevoApiKey,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(createContactBody),
  });

  if (!createResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `Brevo create contact failed: ${createResponse.status} ${createResponse.statusText} at POST https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts`,
    );
  }

  const createData = (await createResponse.json()) as { id: number };
  const contactId = createData.id;

  // Step 2: Add contact to list (even though listIds was used in creation, plan requires this step)
  const addToListBody = {
    contacts: [contactId],
  };

  const addResponse = await fetchImpl(
    `https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/lists/${config.listId}/contacts/add`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'api-key': config.brevoApiKey,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(addToListBody),
    },
  );

  if (!addResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      `Brevo add contact to list failed: ${addResponse.status} ${addResponse.statusText} at POST https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/lists/${config.listId}/contacts/add`,
    );
  }

  return { contactId, listId: config.listId };
}

<file path="README.md">
# Typeform to Brevo Contact Connector

This connector receives a Typeform webhook payload when a form response is submitted, extracts the respondent's email, first name, and last name, creates a contact in Brevo, and subscribes that contact to a configured list.

## What it does

1. **Receives** a Typeform `form_response` webhook payload (POST to your configured webhook URL).
2. **Extracts** the email address (from answer type `email`), first name (first text answer), and last name (second text answer) from the `answers` array.
3. **Creates** a contact in Brevo via `POST https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts` with:
   - `email` (required)
   - `attributes.FNAME` and `attributes.LNAME` (empty strings if not provided)
   - `listIds` containing the configured list ID
4. **Adds** the created contact to the same list via `POST https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts/lists/:listId/contacts/add` (idempotent step per plan).
5. **Returns** the created `contactId` and `listId`.

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `brevoApiKey`   | `BREVO_API_KEY`     | Yes      | Brevo API key with permissions to create contacts and manage lists. |
| `listId`        | `BREVO_LIST_ID`     | Yes      | The static Brevo list ID to which contacts will be added. |
| `fetch`         | —                   | No       | Injected `fetch` implementation (for testing). Defaults to global `fetch`. |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, TypeformWebhookPayload, ConnectorConfig } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  brevoApiKey: process.env.BREVO_API_KEY!,
  listId: Number(process.env.BREVO_LIST_ID!),
};

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Express, Fastify, Cloudflare Worker):
app.post('/webhook/typeform', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const payload = req.body as TypeformWebhookPayload;
    const result = await handle(payload, config);
    res.json({ success: true, ...result });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message });
  }
});
```

## Assumptions

- The Typeform webhook payload includes an `answers` array where:
  - Exactly one answer has `type === 'email'` (provides the email).
  - The first `type === 'text'` answer is the first name.
  - The second `type === 'text'` answer is the last name.
- The Brevo API key (`BREVO_API_KEY`) has permissions to create contacts and manage lists.
- The target Brevo list ID (`BREVO_LIST_ID`) is known and static for this integration.
- The Brevo account uses attribute keys `FNAME` and `LNAME` for first and last name (capitalized as per Brevo convention).
- No authentication is required on the Typeform webhook endpoint itself; security relies on HTTPS and optionally a secret parameter in the webhook URL.
- The connector uses the global `fetch` by default but accepts an injected `fetch` for testing.

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */
export const TARGET_ENDPOINTS: DocumentedEndpoint[] = [
  {
    "method": "POST",
    "url": "https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts",
    "response": {
      "id": 456
    }

        456

      "notAdded": []
    }
  }
]

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

function parseRetryAfter(response: Response): number | null {
  const header = response.headers.get('retry-after')
  if (!header) return null
  const asSeconds = Number(header)
  if (!Number.isNaN(asSeconds)) return asSeconds * 1000
  const asDate = Date.parse(header)
  if (!Number.isNaN(asDate)) return asDate - Date.now()
  return null
}

async function fetchWithRetry(
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
  url: string,
  init: RequestInit,
  maxRetries: number,
  baseMs: number,
): Promise<Response> {
  let attempt = 0
  while (true) {
    const response = await fetchFn(url, init)
    if (response.ok) return response
    const retryable = response.status === 429 || (response.status >= 500 && response.status < 600)
    if (!retryable || attempt >= maxRetries) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status} ${response.statusText} from ${url}`)
    }
    const retryAfter = parseRetryAfter(response)
    const delay = retryAfter ?? baseMs * 2 ** attempt
    if (delay > 0 && Number.isFinite(delay)) {
      await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delay))
    }
    attempt++
  }
}

async function verifySignature(
  secret: string,
  payload: string,
  signatureHex: string,
  timestamp: number,
  webhookTimestamp: number,
): Promise<void> {
  const now = Date.now()
  if (Math.abs(now - timestamp) > TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_MS) {
    throw new Error('Linear-Timestamp outside tolerance window')
  }
  if (Math.abs(timestamp - webhookTimestamp) > TIMESTAMP_TOLERANCE_MS) {
    throw new Error('Webhook timestamp mismatch')
  }

  const expectedPayload = `${timestamp}.${payload}`
  const keyData = new TextEncoder().encode(secret)
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    keyData,
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['verify'],
  )
  const signatureBytes = new Uint8Array(signatureHex.match(/.{1,2}/g)!.map((b) => parseInt(b, 16)))
  const dataBytes = new TextEncoder().encode(expectedPayload)
  const valid = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, signatureBytes, dataBytes)
  if (!valid) throw new Error('Invalid Linear-Signature')
}

  let pages = 0

  const query = `
    query GetComments($id: ID!, $after: String) {
      issue(id: $id) {
        comments(first: 50, after: $after) {
          nodes { id text createdAt user { name } }
          pageInfo { hasNextPage endCursor }
        }
      }
    }
  `

  while (pages < MAX_PAGINATION_PAGES) {
    const variables = { id: issueId, after: cursor }
    const response = await fetchWithRetry(
      fetchFn,
      LINEAR_GRAPHQL_URL,
      {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
      },
      DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES,
      DEFAULT_RETRY_BASE_MS,
    )

    const json = (await response.json()) as GraphQLResponse
    const comments = json.data?.issue?.comments
    if (!comments) break

    allComments.push(...comments.nodes)

    if (!comments.pageInfo.hasNextPage || !comments.pageInfo.endCursor) break
    cursor = comments.pageInfo.endCursor
    pages++
  }

  return allComments
}

async function sendDiscordMessage(
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
  botToken: string,
  channelId: string,
  content: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const truncated = content.slice(0, DISCORD_MAX_LENGTH)
  const response = await fetchWithRetry(
    fetchFn,
    `${DISCORD_API_BASE}/channels/${channelId}/messages`,
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bot ${botToken}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ content: truncated }),
    },
    DEFAULT_MAX_RETRIES,
    DEFAULT_RETRY_BASE_MS,
  )

  const json = (await response.json()) as DiscordResponse
  return json.id
}

export async function handle(
  payload: LinearWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch

  if (!payload.action) throw new Error('Missing action in payload')
  if (!payload.type) throw new Error('Missing type in payload')
  if (!payload.data?.id) throw new Error('Missing data.id in payload')
  if (!payload.data?.stateId) throw new Error('Missing data.stateId in payload')
  if (payload.webhookTimestamp === undefined || payload.webhookTimestamp === null) throw new Error('Missing webhookTimestamp in payload')
  if (!config.linearWebhookSecret) throw new Error('Missing linearWebhookSecret in config')
  if (!config.linearApiKey) throw new Error('Missing linearApiKey in config')
  if (!config.discordBotToken) throw new Error('Missing discordBotToken in config')
  if (!config.discordChannelId) throw new Error('Missing discordChannelId in config')
  if (!config.doneStateId) throw new Error('Missing doneStateId in config')

  if (payload.action !== 'update' || payload.type !== 'Issue') {
    return { discordMessageId: '', commentsFetched: 0 }
  }
  if (payload.data.stateId !== config.doneStateId) {
    return { discordMessageId: '', commentsFetched: 0 }
  }

  if (payload.linearSignature && payload.linearTimestamp) {
    const timestamp = Number(payload.linearTimestamp)
    if (Number.isNaN(timestamp)) throw new Error('Invalid Linear-Timestamp header')
    await verifySignature(
      config.linearWebhookSecret,
      JSON.stringify(payload),
      payload.linearSignature,
      timestamp,
      payload.webhookTimestamp,
    )
  }

  const comments = await fetchComments(fetchFn, config.linearApiKey, payload.data.id)

  const lines = comments.map((c) => `- ${c.user.name}: ${c.text}`)
  const content = `Issue ${payload.data.number} closed\n\nComments:\n${lines.join('\n')}`

  const discordMessageId = await sendDiscordMessage(
    fetchFn,
    config.discordBotToken,
    config.discordChannelId,
    content,
  )

  return { discordMessageId, commentsFetched: comments.length }
}

<file path="README.md">
# Linear Issue Closed → Discord Digest

When a Linear issue is closed, this connector fetches all its comments via cursor pagination and posts a single digest message to a Discord channel.

## What it does

1. Receives a Linear `issue.closed` webhook (POST with JSON body)
2. Verifies the `Linear-Signature` header using the webhook secret
3. Validates the `Linear-Timestamp` header and `webhookTimestamp` field are within 60 seconds
4. Confirms the webhook is for an issue update where `stateId` matches the configured "Done" state
5. Queries Linear's GraphQL API for all comments on that issue using cursor pagination (`first: 50`, `after` cursor)
6. Concatenates all comment texts into a single digest message
7. Sends the digest to a Discord channel via the Discord REST API

## Configuration / Environment Variables

| Config Key | Environment Variable | Description |
|------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `linearWebhookSecret` | `LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Secret for verifying Linear webhook signatures |
| `linearApiKey` | `LINEAR_API_KEY` | Bearer token for Linear GraphQL API |
| `discordBotToken` | `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | Bot token for Discord API (prefixed with `Bot `) |
| `discordChannelId` | `DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` | Target Discord channel ID |
| `doneStateId` | `LINEAR_DONE_STATE_ID` | The `stateId` value that represents a closed/done issue |
| `maxRetries` | — | Optional: max retry attempts for 429/5xx (default: 3) |
| `retryBaseMs` | — | Optional: base delay for exponential backoff in ms (default: 1000) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  linearWebhookSecret: process.env.LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
  linearApiKey: process.env.LINEAR_API_KEY!,
  discordBotToken: process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN!,
  discordChannelId: process.env.DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID!,
  doneStateId: process.env.LINEAR_DONE_STATE_ID!,
  maxRetries: 3,
  retryBaseMs: 1000,
}

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(reqBody, config)
console.log(`Posted digest to Discord: ${result.discordMessageId} (${result.commentsFetched} comments)`)
```

## Assumptions

- The Linear webhook payload includes the issue ID, number, and title when the issue is closed.
- Linear comment objects contain a `text` field with the comment body.
- The Discord channel ID is known and the bot has permission to send messages in that channel.
- The digest is a single concatenated string of all comment texts (not formatted as separate messages).
- Discord message content is limited to 2000 characters; the connector truncates if necessary.
- Linear GraphQL pagination uses Relay-style `first`/`after` arguments; stop when `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is false.
- Maximum 50 pagination pages as a safety cap against runaway loops.
- Retry logic: up to `maxRetries` attempts after the initial request for 429 and 5xx responses, with exponential backoff and `Retry-After` header support.
- Webhook signature verification uses HMAC-SHA256 with the payload format `{timestamp}.{payload}`.
- The `linearSignature` and `linearTimestamp` fields are optional in the payload for testing; in production they come from HTTP headers.

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}
