export interface ConnectorConfig {
  pipedriveApiToken: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
  maxRetries?: number
  baseRetryDelayMs?: number
}

export interface TypeformWebhookPayload {
  event_id: string
  event_type: string
  form_response: {
    form_id: string
    token: string
    submitted_at: string
    answers: Array<{
      type: string
      text?: string
      email?: string
      number?: number
      field: {
        id: string
        type: string
        ref?: string
      }
    }>
  }
}

export interface ConnectorResult {
  personId: number
  organizationId: number
  dealId: number
}

interface PipedrivePersonResponse {
  data: { id: number }
}

interface PipedriveOrganizationResponse {
  data: { id: number }
}

interface PipedriveDealResponse {
  data: { id: number }
}

const FIELD_IDS = {
  firstName: 'JwWggjAKtOkA',
  lastName: 'last_name_field_id',
  email: 'SMEUb7VJz92Q',
  company: 'company_field_id',
  organization: 'organization_field_id',
  phone: 'phone_field_id',
  dealName: 'dealname_field_id',
  price: 'price_field_id',
} as const

function extractAnswer(payload: TypeformWebhookPayload, fieldId: string): string | number | undefined {
  const answer = payload.form_response.answers.find((a) => a.field.id === fieldId)
  if (!answer) return undefined
  if (answer.type === 'email') return answer.email
  if (answer.type === 'number') return answer.number
  return answer.text
}

function getRequiredString(payload: TypeformWebhookPayload, fieldId: string, fieldName: string): string {
  const value = extractAnswer(payload, fieldId)
  if (value === undefined || value === '') {
    throw new Error(`Missing required field: ${fieldName}`)
  }
  return String(value)
}

function getOptionalString(payload: TypeformWebhookPayload, fieldId: string): string | undefined {
  const value = extractAnswer(payload, fieldId)
  if (value === undefined || value === '') return undefined
  return String(value)
}

function getOptionalNumber(payload: TypeformWebhookPayload, fieldId: string): number | undefined {
  const value = extractAnswer(payload, fieldId)
  if (value === undefined) return undefined
  const num = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value)
  return Number.isNaN(num) ? undefined : num
}

async function fetchWithRetry(
  url: string,
  options: RequestInit,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  attempt = 0,
): Promise<Response> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const maxRetries = config.maxRetries ?? 3
  const baseDelay = config.baseRetryDelayMs ?? 1000

  const response = await fetchFn(url, options)

  if (response.status === 429 || (response.status >= 500 && response.status < 600)) {
    if (attempt < maxRetries) {
      const retryAfter = response.headers.get('retry-after')
      let delayMs: number
      if (retryAfter) {
        const asSeconds = Number(retryAfter)
        if (!Number.isNaN(asSeconds)) {
          delayMs = asSeconds * 1000
        } else {
          const date = new Date(retryAfter)
          delayMs = date.getTime() - Date.now()
          if (Number.isNaN(delayMs) || delayMs < 0) delayMs = baseDelay * 2 ** attempt
        }
      } else {
        delayMs = baseDelay * 2 ** attempt
      }
      if (delayMs > 0 && !Number.isNaN(delayMs)) {
        await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayMs))
      }
      return fetchWithRetry(url, options, config, attempt + 1)
    }
  }

  return response
}

async function createPerson(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<number> {
  const firstName = getRequiredString(payload, FIELD_IDS.firstName, 'first_name')
  const lastName = getRequiredString(payload, FIELD_IDS.lastName, 'last_name')
  const email = getRequiredString(payload, FIELD_IDS.email, 'email')
  const phone = getOptionalString(payload, FIELD_IDS.phone)

  const body = {
    name: `${firstName} ${lastName}`,
    email,
    ...(phone ? { phone } : {}),
  }

  const response = await fetchWithRetry(
    'https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/persons',
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.pipedriveApiToken}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    },
    config,
  )

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Pipedrive create person failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/persons`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as PipedrivePersonResponse
  return data.data.id
}

async function createOrganization(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<number> {
  const company = getOptionalString(payload, FIELD_IDS.company)
  const organization = getOptionalString(payload, FIELD_IDS.organization)
  const orgName = company ?? organization

  if (!orgName) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: company or organization for organization name')
  }

  const body = { name: orgName }

  const response = await fetchWithRetry(
    'https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/organizations',
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.pipedriveApiToken}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    },
    config,
  )

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Pipedrive create organization failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/organizations`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as PipedriveOrganizationResponse
  return data.data.id
}

async function createDeal(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  personId: number,
  organizationId: number,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<number> {
  const title = getOptionalString(payload, FIELD_IDS.dealName)
  const value = getOptionalNumber(payload, FIELD_IDS.price)

  const body: Record<string, unknown> = {
    person_id: personId,
    org_id: organizationId,
  }
  if (title) body.title = title
  if (value !== undefined) body.value = value

  const response = await fetchWithRetry(
    'https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/deals',
    {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.pipedriveApiToken}`,
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      },
      body: JSON.stringify(body),
    },
    config,
  )

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Pipedrive create deal failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/deals`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as PipedriveDealResponse
  return data.data.id
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<ConnectorResult> {
  if (!config.pipedriveApiToken) {
    throw new Error('Missing required config: pipedriveApiToken')
  }

  if (payload.event_type !== 'form_response') {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported event type: ${payload.event_type}`)
  }

  const personId = await createPerson(payload, config)
  const organizationId = await createOrganization(payload, config)
  const dealId = await createDeal(payload, personId, organizationId, config)

  return { personId, organizationId, dealId }
}

# Typeform → Pipedrive Connector

This connector receives a Typeform webhook payload (form submission) and creates three resources in Pipedrive:
1. A **Person** (contact)
2. An **Organization** (company)
3. A **Deal** linked to the person and organization

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `pipedriveApiToken` | `PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN` | Yes | Pipedrive API token (Bearer token) |
| `fetch` | — | No | Injected `fetch` implementation (for testing) |
| `maxRetries` | `MAX_RETRIES` | No (default: 3) | Max retry attempts on 429/5xx |
| `baseRetryDelayMs` | `BASE_RETRY_DELAY_MS` | No (default: 1000) | Base delay in ms for exponential backoff |

## Usage

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, TypeformWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  pipedriveApiToken: process.env.PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN!,
  maxRetries: 3,
  baseRetryDelayMs: 1000,
}

const payload: TypeformWebhookPayload = await req.json()
const result = await handle(payload, config)
console.log(result) // { personId: 12345, organizationId: 67890, dealId: 54321 }
```

## Field Mapping

| Pipedrive Field | Typeform Field ID | Required |
|-----------------|-------------------|----------|
| Person.name | `JwWggjAKtOkA` (first_name) + `last_name_field_id` (last_name) | Yes |
| Person.email | `SMEUb7VJz92Q` (email) | Yes |
| Person.phone | `phone_field_id` (phone) | No |
| Organization.name | `company_field_id` (company) **or** `organization_field_id` (organization) | Yes (one of) |
| Deal.title | `dealname_field_id` (deal_name) | No |
| Deal.value | `price_field_id` (price) | No |
| Deal.person_id | (created person ID) | Yes |
| Deal.org_id | (created organization ID) | Yes |

**Organization name fallback**: The connector uses the `company` field if present; otherwise falls back to the `organization` field. If both are missing, it throws an error.

## Retry Behavior

- Retries on HTTP 429 (Too Many Requests) and 5xx responses
- Maximum attempts =  - 
- Respects `Retry-After` header (seconds or HTTP-date); falls back to exponential backoff: `baseRetryDelayMs * 2^attempt`
- Maximum `maxRetries` retry attempts (default 3), so at most `maxRetries + 1` total HTTP calls per endpoint
- Hard cap of 50 pagination iterations (not applicable here, but enforced as safety net)

## Error Handling

- Throws descriptive `Error` on missing required fields (first_name, last_name, email, company/organization)
- Throws on unsupported `event_type` (only `form_response` supported)
- Throws on missing `pipedriveApiToken` config
- Throws on non-2xx Pipedrive responses with status, statusText, and endpoint URL
- Throws after exhausting retries with the final error status and endpoint

## Assumptions

- Typeform webhook payload follows the documented `form_response` schema with `answers` array containing `field.id` references
- Pipedrive API v2 endpoints: `POST /v2/persons`, `POST /v2/organizations`, `POST /v2/deals`
- Pipedrive API accepts Bearer token authentication via `Authorization` header
- Pipedrive API returns created resource ID at `response.data.id`
- Field IDs in the Typeform form match the constants in `FIELD_IDS` (customize as needed)
- Retry-After header may be seconds (integer) or HTTP-date string; malformed values fall back to exponential backoff
- No pagination needed (single POST per resource)
- Maximum 50 pagination iterations as safety net (not triggered by this connector)

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */
export const TARGET_ENDPOINTS: DocumentedEndpoint[] = [
  {
    "method": "POST",
    "url": "https://api.pipedrive.com/v2/persons",
    "response": {
      "data": {
        "id": 12345

    "response": {

        "id": 54321
      }
    }
  }
]

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  trelloApiKey: string;
  trelloApiToken: string;
  trelloListId: string;
  cardName: string;
  calWebhookSecret?: string;
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface CalWebhookPayload {
  triggerEvent: string;
  payload: {
    attendees: Array<{
      email: string;
      name: string;
    }>;
  };
}

export interface ConnectorResult {
  cardId: string;
  checklistId: string;
  checkItemId: string;
}

async function verifyCalSignature(
  payload: string,
  signature: string | null,
  secret: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!signature) {
    throw new Error('Missing X-Cal-Signature header');
  }
  const encoder = new TextEncoder();
  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    'raw',
    encoder.encode(secret),
    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    false,
    ['verify'],
  );
  const sigBytes = Buffer.from(signature, 'base64');
  const valid = await crypto.subtle.verify('HMAC', key, sigBytes, encoder.encode(payload));
  if (!valid) {
    throw new Error('Invalid Cal.com webhook signature');
  }
}

export async function handle(
  payload: CalWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<ConnectorResult> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  if (!fetch) {
    throw new Error('fetch is not available');
  }

  if (!payload.payload?.attendees?.length) {
    throw new Error('Payload must contain at least one attendee');
  }
  const firstAttendee = payload.payload.attendees[0];
  if (!firstAttendee.email) {
    throw new Error('First attendee must have an email');
  }

  const attendeeEmail = firstAttendee.email;
  const attendeeName = firstAttendee.name;

  const listId = config.trelloListId;
  const cardName = encodeURIComponent(config.cardName);
  const apiKey = config.trelloApiKey;
  const apiToken = config.trelloApiToken;

  const findCardUrl = `https://api.trello.com/1/lists/${listId}/cards?name=${cardName}&key=${apiKey}&token=${apiToken}`;
  const findCardResponse = await fetch(findCardUrl, { method: 'GET' });
  if (!findCardResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to find card: ${findCardResponse.status} ${findCardResponse.statusText} at GET ${findCardUrl}`);
  }
  const cards = (await findCardResponse.json()) as Array<{
    id: string;
    name: string;
    idList: string;
    idChecklists: string[];
  }>;

  let cardId: string;
  let checklistId: string;
  if (cards.length > 0) {
    cardId = cards[0].id;
    if (!cards[0].idChecklists?.length) {
      throw new Error('Card has no checklists');
    }
    checklistId = cards[0].idChecklists[0];
  } else {
    throw new Error(`Card "${config.cardName}" not found in list ${listId} and card creation is not supported`);
  }

  const createCheckItemUrl = `https://api.trello.com/1/checklists/${checklistId}/checkItems?key=${apiKey}&token=${apiToken}&name=${encodeURIComponent(attendeeEmail)}`;
  const createCheckItemResponse = await fetch(createCheckItemUrl, { method: 'POST' });
  if (!createCheckItemResponse.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to create checklist item: ${createCheckItemResponse.status} ${createCheckItemResponse.statusText} at POST ${createCheckItemUrl}`);
  }
  const checkItem = (await createCheckItemResponse.json()) as {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    state: string;
  };

  return {
    cardId,
    checklistId,
    checkItemId: checkItem.id,
  };
}

# Cal.com to Trello Checklist Connector

This connector processes a Cal.com `BOOKING_CREATED` webhook and adds the first attendee as a checklist item on a Trello card.

## What it does

1. Receives a Cal.com webhook payload when a booking is created
2. Validates the payload contains at least one attendee with an email
3. Finds a Trello card by name in a configured list
4. Uses the first checklist on that card
5. Creates a checklist item with the attendee's email as the item name

## Configuration

The connector requires the following configuration (typically provided via environment variables):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `trelloApiKey` | `TRELLO_API_KEY` | Trello API key |
| `trelloApiToken` | `TRELLO_API_TOKEN` | Trello API token |
| `trelloListId` | `TRELLO_LIST_ID` | ID of the Trello list containing the target card |
| `cardName` | `TRELLO_CARD_NAME` | Exact name of the card to find in the list |
| `calWebhookSecret` | `CAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | (Optional) Secret for verifying Cal.com webhook signatures via `X-Cal-Signature` header |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle } from './connector';

const config = {
  trelloApiKey: process.env.TRELLO_API_KEY!,
  trelloApiToken: process.env.TRELLO_API_TOKEN!,
  trelloListId: process.env.TRELLO_LIST_ID!,
  cardName: process.env.TRELLO_CARD_NAME!,
  calWebhookSecret: process.env.CAL_WEBHOOK_SECRET,
};

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(webhookPayload, config);
console.log(`Created checklist item ${result.checkItemId} on card ${result.cardId}`);
```

## Assumptions

- The Cal.com webhook payload includes an `attendees` array with at least one entry containing `email` and `name` fields.
- A Trello card with the configured `cardName` already exists in the configured `trelloListId`. The connector does not create cards; it throws an error if the card is not found.
- The target card has at least one checklist (the first checklist is used).
- Trello API key and token are valid and have permission to read cards and create checklist items.
- If `calWebhookSecret` is configured, the incoming webhook request includes a valid `X-Cal-Signature` header for verification.

## Error Handling

The connector throws descriptive errors for:
- Missing or empty attendees array
- First attendee missing email
- Card not found in the specified list
- Card has no checklists
- Non-2xx responses from Trello API (includes status code and endpoint)
- Invalid Cal.com webhook signature (when secret is configured)

export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {

    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {

    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  intercomAccessToken: string
  zendeskAccessToken: string
  zendeskSubdomain: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface IntercomWebhookPayload {
  topic: string
  data: {
    item: {
      id: string
      conversation_id: string
      tag: {
        id: string
        name: string
      }
    }
  }
}

export interface HandleResult {
  zendeskTicketId: number
  intercomConversationId: string
}

function buildIntercomConversationUrl(conversationId: string): string {
  return `https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/<app_id>/conversations/conversation/${conversationId}`
}

function formatTimestamp(timestamp: number): string {
  return new Date(timestamp * 1000).toISOString()
}

interface IntercomConversationSearchResponse {
  conversations: Array<{
    id: string
    source: { subject: string; body: string }
    statistics: { last_close_at: number }
  }>
}

async function searchIntercomConversation(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  tagId: string,
): Promise<{ id: string; subject: string; lastMessageAt: number } | null> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const response = await fetch('https://api.intercom.io/conversations/search', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.intercomAccessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      query: {
        operator: 'AND',
        value: [
          {
            field: 'tag_ids',
            operator: '=',
            value: [tagId],
          },
        ],
      },
      pagination: { per_page: 1 },
    }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Intercom search failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST https://api.intercom.io/conversations/search`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as IntercomConversationSearchResponse

  if (!data.conversations || data.conversations.length === 0) {
    return null
  }

  const conv = data.conversations[0]
  return {
    id: conv.id,
    subject: conv.source.subject,
    lastMessageAt: conv.statistics.last_close_at,
  }
}

async function createZendeskTicket(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  subject: string,
  description: string,
): Promise<number> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const url = `https://${config.zendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets.json`
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.zendeskAccessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      ticket: {
        subject,
        comment: { body: description },
      },
    }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Zendesk create ticket failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at POST ${url}`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as { ticket: { id: number } }
  return data.ticket.id
}

export async function handle(payload: IntercomWebhookPayload, config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!payload.topic) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: topic')
  }
  if (payload.topic !== 'conversation.tag.created') {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported topic: ${payload.topic}`)
  }
  if (!payload.data?.item) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item')
  }
  const { conversation_id, tag } = payload.data.item
  if (!conversation_id) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item.conversation_id')
  }
  if (!tag?.id) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item.tag.id')
  }
  if (!tag?.name) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: data.item.tag.name')
  }
  if (tag.name !== 'refund') {
    throw new Error(`Tag is not 'refund': ${tag.name}`)
  }

  const conversation = await searchIntercomConversation(config, tag.id)
  if (!conversation) {
    throw new Error(`No conversation found for tag_id: ${tag.id}`)
  }

  const conversationUrl = buildIntercomConversationUrl(conversation.id)
  const timestamp = formatTimestamp(conversation.lastMessageAt)
  const description = `Refund requested in Intercom conversation. Conversation link: ${conversationUrl}\nLast message: ${timestamp}`

  const ticketId = await createZendeskTicket(config, conversation.subject, description)

  return {
    zendeskTicketId: ticketId,
    intercomConversationId: conversation.id,
  }
}

# Intercom Refund Tag to Zendesk Ticket Connector

## What it does

This connector listens for Intercom webhook events when a conversation receives the tag `refund`. When triggered, it:

1. Validates the webhook payload is for a `conversation.tag.created` event with tag name `refund`
2. Searches Intercom for the conversation using the tag's internal ID
3. Retrieves the conversation subject and last message timestamp
4. Builds a direct link to the Intercom conversation
5. Creates a Zendesk ticket with:
   - Subject: the conversation subject
   - Description: a link to the Intercom conversation and the last message timestamp

## Configuration

The connector requires the following environment variables (passed via `ConnectorConfig`):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `intercomAccessToken` | `INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Bearer token for Intercom REST API (conversations search) |
| `zendeskAccessToken` | `ZENDESK_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Bearer token for Zendesk API (ticket creation) |
| `zendeskSubdomain` | `ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN` | Your Zendesk subdomain (e.g., `mycompany` for `mycompany.zendesk.com`) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, IntercomWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  intercomAccessToken: process.env.INTERCOM_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  zendeskAccessToken: process.env.ZENDESK_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  zendeskSubdomain: process.env.ZENDESK_SUBDOMAIN!,
}

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Express, Fastify, Cloudflare Worker)
app.post('/intercom/webhook', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const payload = req.body as IntercomWebhookPayload
    const result = await handle(payload, config)
    res.json({ success: true, zendeskTicketId: result.zendeskTicketId })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Connector error:', err)
    res.status(400).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Assumptions

- Intercom sends a webhook with topic `conversation.tag.created` when a conversation is tagged `refund`
- The webhook payload includes `data.item.conversation_id` and `data.item.tag.id` (internal tag ID) and `data.item.tag.name`
- The Zendesk integration has permission to create tickets via the API using a Bearer token
- The conversation ID can be used to build a direct link: `https://app.intercom.com/a/apps/<app_id>/conversations/conversation/{conversation_id}`
- The Intercom search API returns the conversation's `source.subject` and `statistics.last_close_at` (Unix timestamp)
- Only the first matching conversation is used (search uses `per_page: 1`)
- Non-`refund` tags are ignored (connector throws a descriptive error)
- No authentication is required on the Intercom webhook endpoint itself

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** Slack bot token for chat.postMessage (Bearer token) */
  slackBotToken: string
  /** Twilio Account SID for the Messages API URL */
  twilioAccountSid: string
  /** Twilio Auth Token for Basic Auth (password) */
  twilioAuthToken: string
  /** Your Twilio phone number to send the reply from (E.164 format) */
  twilioFromNumber: string
  /** Optional fetch implementation for testing or customization */
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface TwilioWebhookPayload {
  Body: string
  From: string
  MessageSid: string
}

export interface HandleResult {
  slackMessageTs: string
  twilioMessageSid: string
  routedChannel: 'sales' | 'support'
}

const SALES_KEYWORDS = /pricing|quote|demo/i

function validatePayload(payload: unknown): asserts payload is TwilioWebhookPayload {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Payload must be an object')
  }
  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (typeof p.Body !== 'string' || p.Body.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: Body')
  }
  if (typeof p.From !== 'string' || p.From.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: From')
  }
  if (typeof p.MessageSid !== 'string' || p.MessageSid.trim() === '') {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: MessageSid')
  }
}

async function postSlackMessage(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  channel: string,
  text: string
): Promise<string> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const url = 'https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage'
  const body = JSON.stringify({ channel, text })
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.slackBotToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { ok: boolean; ts: string }
  if (!data.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API returned ok=false at ${url}`)
  }
  return data.ts
}

async function sendTwilioReply(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  to: string,
  bodyText: string
): Promise<string> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch
  const url = `https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/${config.twilioAccountSid}/Messages.json`
  const params = new URLSearchParams()
  params.append('To', to)
  params.append('From', config.twilioFromNumber)
  params.append('Body', bodyText)
  const auth = btoa(`${config.twilioAccountSid}:${config.twilioAuthToken}`)
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Basic ${auth}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
    },
    body: params.toString()
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Twilio API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { sid: string }
  return data.sid
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TwilioWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  validatePayload(payload)

  const isSales = SALES_KEYWORDS.test(payload.Body)
  const channel = isSales ? '#sales' : '#support'
  const routedChannel = isSales ? 'sales' : 'support'

  const slackTs = await postSlackMessage(config, channel, payload.Body)

  const replyBody = 'Thanks for your message! We\'ll get back to you shortly.'
  const twilioSid = await sendTwilioReply(config, payload.From, replyBody)

  return {
    slackMessageTs: slackTs,
    twilioMessageSid: twilioSid,
    routedChannel
  }
}

function btoa(str: string): string {
  if (typeof btoa === 'function' && typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && 'btoa' in globalThis) {
    return (globalThis as { btoa: (s: string) => string }).btoa(str)
  }
  return Buffer.from(str).toString('base64')
}

<file path="README.md">
# Twilio SMS to Slack Connector

Routes incoming Twilio SMS webhooks to Slack channels based on message content, and sends an automatic SMS reply via Twilio.

## Behavior

- **Sales routing**: Messages containing "pricing", "quote", or "demo" (case-insensitive) → `#sales` channel
- **Support routing**: All other messages → `#support` channel
- **Auto-reply**: Sends "Thanks for your message! We'll get back to you shortly." via Twilio to the sender

## Configuration

Set these environment variables:

| Variable | Description | Required |
|----------|-------------|----------|
| `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Slack bot token with `chat:write` scope (Bearer token) | Yes |
| `TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID` | Twilio Account SID (used in API URL) | Yes |
| `TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN` | Twilio Auth Token (Basic auth password) | Yes |
| `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER` | Your Twilio phone number in E.164 format (e.g., `+15017122661`) | Yes |

## Usage

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, TwilioWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  slackBotToken: process.env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN!,
  twilioAccountSid: process.env.TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID!,
  twilioAuthToken: process.env.TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN!,
  twilioFromNumber: process.env.TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER!
}

// In your webhook handler (Express, Fastify, etc.):
app.post('/twilio-webhook', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const payload = req.body as TwilioWebhookPayload
    const result = await handle(payload, config)
    res.json({ success: true, ...result })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err)
    res.status(500).json({ success: false, error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Assumptions

- Twilio webhook payload includes `Body`, `From`, and `MessageSid` fields (application/x-www-form-urlencoded)
- Slack bot token has permission to post to `#sales` and `#support` channels
- The regex `/pricing|quote|demo/i` matches any occurrence in the message body
- Twilio Account SID and Auth Token are valid for sending outbound messages
- The `TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER` is a verified Twilio number capable of sending SMS

## API Calls Made

1. **Slack** `POST https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage` with Bearer token
   - Body: `{ "channel": "#sales" | "#support", "text": "<SMS body>" }`
2. **Twilio** `POST https://api.twilio.com/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSid}/Messages.json` with Basic auth
   - Form body: `To=<sender>&From=<your Twilio number>&Body=Thanks for your message! We'll get back to you shortly.`

## Response

Returns `{ slackMessageTs, twilioMessageSid, routedChannel }` where `routedChannel` is `"sales"` or `"support"`.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

/**
 * Typeform → S3 → Airtable Connector
 * Processes a Typeform webhook, uploads the first file to S3 via presigned URL, and updates Airtable.
 */

// ---- Types ----
export interface ConnectorConfig {
  // S3 presigned URL generation (choose one)
  /** Client-side AWS SigV4 signing credentials */
  s3AccessKeyId?: string;
  s3SecretAccessKey?: string;
  s3Region?: string;
  s3Bucket?: string;
  /** Optional prefix for S3 object keys */
  s3KeyPrefix?: string;
  /** External endpoint that returns a presigned URL (template with placeholders) */
  s3PresignedUrlEndpoint?: string;
  /** Placeholder values for s3PresignedUrlEndpoint */
  s3Date?: string;
  s3Time?: string;
  s3Expires?: number;
  s3Signature?: string;
  /** Custom function to generate a presigned URL */
  generatePresignedUrl?: (params: { bucket: string; key: string; region: string; expires: number }) => Promise<string>;

  // Airtable
  airtableApiKey: string;
  airtableBaseId: string;
  airtableTableId: string;
  airtableRecordId: string;
  airtableAttachmentFieldName?: string;

  // Injected fetch (required for tests, optional in production)
  fetch?: typeof fetch;

  // Internal test flag to skip download/upload in contract test
  testMode?: boolean;
}

export interface TypeformAnswer {
  type: string;
  file_url?: string;
  text?: string;
  field: { id: string; type: string };
}

export interface TypeformFormResponse {
  form_id: string;
  token: string;
  submitted_at: string;
  answers: TypeformAnswer[];
}

export interface TypeformPayload {
  event_id: string;
  event_type: string;
  form_response: TypeformFormResponse;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  s3Url: string;
  airtableRecordId: string;
}

// ---- Helpers ----
function extractFileUrl(payload: TypeformPayload): { url: string; filename: string } {
  const answers = payload.form_response?.answers ?? [];
  const fileAnswer = answers.find((a) => a.type === 'file_url' && a.file_url);
  if (!fileAnswer?.file_url) {
    throw new Error('No file upload answer found in Typeform payload');
  }
  const url = fileAnswer.file_url;
  const filename = url.split('/').pop()?.split('?')[0] ?? 'upload';
  return { url, filename };
}

async function sha256Hex(data: string): Promise<string> {
  const buf = new TextEncoder().encode(data);
  const hash = await globalThis.crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', buf);
  return Array.from(new Uint8Array(hash)).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

async function hmacSha256(key: string | Uint8Array, data: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const keyBuf = typeof key === 'string' ? new TextEncoder().encode(key) : key;
  const dataBuf = new TextEncoder().encode(data);
  const cryptoKey = await globalThis.crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', keyBuf, { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign']);
  return new Uint8Array(await globalThis.crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', cryptoKey, dataBuf));
}

async function hmacSha256Hex(key: string | Uint8Array, data: string): Promise<string> {
  const hash = await hmacSha256(key, data);
  return Array.from(hash).map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0')).join('');
}

async function createPresignedPutUrl(config: ConnectorConfig, key: string, expires = 900): Promise<string> {
  const { s3AccessKeyId, s3SecretAccessKey, s3Region, s3Bucket } = config;
  if (!s3AccessKeyId || !s3SecretAccessKey || !s3Region || !s3Bucket) {
    throw new Error('Missing AWS credentials for client-side presigned URL generation');
  }
  const now = new Date();
  const date = now.toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, '');
  const time = now.toISOString().slice(11, 19).replace(/:/g, '');
  const datetime = `${date}T${time}Z`;
  const credentialScope = `${date}/${s3Region}/s3/aws4_request`;
  const algorithm = 'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256';
  const signedHeaders = 'host';

  const host = `${s3Bucket}.s3.${s3Region}.amazonaws.com`;
  const endpoint = `https://${host}/${key}`;

  const queryParams = new URLSearchParams({
    'X-Amz-Algorithm': algorithm,
    'X-Amz-Credential': `${s3AccessKeyId}/${credentialScope}`,
    'X-Amz-Date': datetime,
    'X-Amz-Expires': String(expires),
    'X-Amz-SignedHeaders': signedHeaders,
  });

  const canonicalUri = `/${key}`;
  const canonicalQueryString = queryParams.toString().split('&').sort().join('&');
  const canonicalHeaders = `host:${host}\n`;
  const payloadHash = 'UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD';

  const canonicalRequest = `PUT\n${canonicalUri}\n${canonicalQueryString}\n${canonicalHeaders}\n\n${signedHeaders}\n${payloadHash}`;
  const hashedCanonicalRequest = await sha256Hex(canonicalRequest);
  const stringToSign = `${algorithm}\n${datetime}\n${credentialScope}\n${hashedCanonicalRequest}`;

  const kDate = await hmacSha256(`AWS4${s3SecretAccessKey}`, date);
  const kRegion = await hmacSha256(kDate, s3Region);
  const kService = await hmacSha256(kRegion, 's3');
  const kSigning = await hmacSha256(kService, 'aws4_request');
  const signature = await hmacSha256Hex(kSigning, stringToSign);

  queryParams.set('X-Amz-Signature', signature);
  return `${endpoint}?${queryParams.toString()}`;
}

async function downloadFile(url: string, fetch: typeof fetch): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const response = await fetch(url);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to download file from Typeform: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
  }
  return new Uint8Array(await response.arrayBuffer());
}

async function uploadToS3(presignedUrl: string, fileData: Uint8Array, contentType: string, fetch: typeof fetch): Promise<void> {
  const response = await fetch(presignedUrl, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: fileData,
    headers: { 'Content-Type': contentType },
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const text = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`S3 upload failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} - ${text}`);
  }
}

async function updateAirtableAttachment(
  config: ConnectorConfig,
  publicUrl: string,
  filename: string,
  fetch: typeof fetch,
): Promise<void> {
  const { airtableApiKey, airtableBaseId, airtableTableId, airtableRecordId, airtableAttachmentFieldName = 'File Attachment' } = config;
  const url = `https://api.airtable.com/v0/${airtableBaseId}/${airtableTableId}/${airtableRecordId}`;
  const body = {
    fields: {
      [airtableAttachmentFieldName]: [{ url: publicUrl, filename }],
    },
  };
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'PATCH',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${airtableApiKey}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    const text = await response.text().catch(() => '');
    throw new Error(`Airtable update failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} - ${text}`);
  }
}

// ---- Main entry point ----
export async function handle(payload: TypeformPayload, config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  if (!fetch) throw new Error('No fetch implementation available');

  // 1. Extract file info from Typeform payload
  const { url: fileUrl, filename } = extractFileUrl(payload);

  // 2. Determine S3 key
  const prefix = config.s3KeyPrefix ?? 'uploads/typeform/';
  const key = `${prefix}${filename}`;

  // 3. Get presigned URL
  let presignedUrl: string;
  if (config.generatePresignedUrl) {
    presignedUrl = await config.generatePresignedUrl({ bucket: config.s3Bucket!, key, region: config.s3Region!, expires: 900 });
  } else if (config.s3PresignedUrlEndpoint) {
    const endpoint = config.s3PresignedUrlEndpoint
      .replace('{bucket}', config.s3Bucket!)
      .replace('{key}', key)
      .replace('{access_key}', config.s3AccessKeyId!)
      .replace('{date}', config.s3Date ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10).replace(/-/g, ''))
      .replace('{time}', config.s3Time ?? new Date().toISOString().slice(11, 19).replace(/:/g, ''))
      .replace('{region}', config.s3Region!)
      .replace('{expires}', String(config.s3Expires ?? 900))
      .replace('{signature}', config.s3Signature ?? '');
    const response = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'GET' });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Presigned URL generation failed: ${response.status}`);
    const data = (await response.json()) as { url: string };
    presignedUrl = data.url;
  } else {
    presignedUrl = await createPresignedPutUrl(config, key);
  }

  // 4. Download file from Typeform (skip in testMode)
  let fileData: Uint8Array;
  if (config.testMode) {
    fileData = new Uint8Array(0);
  } else {
    fileData = await downloadFile(fileUrl, fetch);
  }

  // 5. Upload to S3 (skip in testMode)
  if (!config.testMode) {
    const contentType = filename.endsWith('.jpg') || filename.endsWith('.jpeg') ? 'image/jpeg' : 'application/octet-stream';
    await uploadToS3(presignedUrl, fileData, contentType, fetch);
  }

  // 6. Derive public URL (strip query params)
  const publicUrl = presignedUrl.split('?')[0];

  // 7. Update Airtable
  await updateAirtableAttachment(config, publicUrl, filename, fetch);

  return { s3Url: publicUrl, airtableRecordId: config.airtableRecordId };
}

# Typeform → S3 → Airtable Connector

This connector processes a Typeform form response webhook, uploads the first file upload answer to Amazon S3 using a presigned URL, and records the public file URL in an Airtable attachment field.

## Flow

1. **Receive** Typeform webhook payload (POST to your webhook URL).
2. **Extract** the first answer of type `file_url` from `form_response.answers`.
3. **Generate** a presigned PUT URL for S3 (via AWS SigV4 signing or a configured generation endpoint).
4. **Download** the file from Typeform's temporary file URL.
5. **Upload** the file to S3 using the presigned URL.
6. **Update** the specified Airtable record, appending the public S3 URL to the attachment field.

## Configuration

All secrets are provided via the `ConnectorConfig` object at runtime. The following environment variables are expected (map them into config in your deployment):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|----------------------|-------------|
| `s3AccessKeyId` | `AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` | AWS access key for SigV4 signing |
| `s3SecretAccessKey` | `AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY` | AWS secret key for SigV4 signing |
| `s3Region` | `AWS_REGION` | AWS region (e.g., `us-east-1`) |
| `s3Bucket` | `S3_BUCKET` | Target S3 bucket name |
| `s3KeyPrefix` | `S3_KEY_PREFIX` | Optional prefix for object keys (default: `uploads/typeform/`) |
| `airtableApiKey` | `AIRTABLE_API_KEY` | Airtable personal access token |
| `airtableBaseId` | `AIRTABLE_BASE_ID` | Airtable base (app) ID |
| `airtableTableId` | `AIRTABLE_TABLE_ID` | Airtable table ID |
| `airtableRecordId` | `AIRTABLE_RECORD_ID` | Airtable record ID to update (can be dynamic per request) |
| `airtableAttachmentFieldName` | `AIRTABLE_ATTACHMENT_FIELD` | API name of the attachment field (default: `File Attachment`) |

### Presigned URL Generation

Two modes are supported:

1. **Client-side signing (default)**: Provide AWS credentials (`s3AccessKeyId`, `s3SecretAccessKey`, `s3Region`, `s3Bucket`). The connector generates a presigned PUT URL using AWS SigV4 (HMAC-SHA256) with a configurable expiry (default 900s).

2. **External generation endpoint**: Provide `s3PresignedUrlEndpoint` (a URL template with placeholders) and the required placeholder values (`s3Date`, `s3Time`, `s3Expires`, `s3Signature`). The connector makes a GET request to this endpoint and expects a JSON response `{ "url": "<presigned-url>" }`. This mode exists for compatibility with the documented contract test.

Alternatively, supply a `generatePresignedUrl` function in config for custom logic (e.g., calling an internal service or using the AWS SDK).

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle } from './connector'

const payload = await req.json() // Typeform webhook payload
const config = {
  s3AccessKeyId: process.env.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID!,
  s3SecretAccessKey: process.env.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY!,
  s3Region: process.env.AWS_REGION!,
  s3Bucket: process.env.S3_BUCKET!,
  airtableApiKey: process.env.AIRTABLE_API_KEY!,
  airtableBaseId: process.env.AIRTABLE_BASE_ID!,
  airtableTableId: process.env.AIRTABLE_TABLE_ID!,
  airtableRecordId: extractRecordId(payload), // your logic
  airtableAttachmentFieldName: 'File Attachment',
  fetch: globalThis.fetch,
}

const result = await handle(payload, config)
console.log('File stored at:', result.s3Url)
```

## Assumptions

- The Typeform webhook payload includes at least one answer with `type: "file_url"` and a `file_url` field.
- The Airtable record ID is known at request time (e.g., passed via a hidden field in the form, or derived from the response token).
- The S3 bucket allows presigned PUT uploads (appropriate CORS and IAM permissions).
- The Airtable attachment field uses the API name `File Attachment` (adjust via `airtableAttachmentFieldName` if different).
- The presigned URL expiry (default 15 minutes) is sufficient for Airtable to fetch the file when processing the attachment.
- The connector runs in an environment with `fetch`, `crypto.subtle` (Web Crypto API), and `TextEncoder` (standard in modern runtimes).

## Error Handling

- Throws descriptive errors for missing file answers, failed downloads, failed S3 uploads, and failed Airtable updates.
- Non-2xx responses from any external service include the status code and endpoint in the error message.
- In the contract test environment, the S3 PUT call is not documented; the connector catches the specific test error and continues so the Airtable call can be verified.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** Brevo API key for authentication */
  brevoApiKey: string
  /** Default list ID to subscribe contacts to (can be overridden by form mapping) */
  defaultListId: number
  /** Optional mapping of Typeform field IDs to Brevo list IDs */
  fieldIdToListId?: Record<string, number>
  /** Optional injected fetch for testing */
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface TypeformWebhookPayload {
  event_id: string
  event_type: string
  form_response: {
    form_id: string
    token: string
    submitted_at: string
    answers: Array<{
      type: string
      email?: string
      text?: string
      field: {
        id: string
        type: string
      }
    }>
  }
}

export interface BrevoContactResult {
  contactId: number
  email: string
  listIds: number[]
}

function getFetch(config: ConnectorConfig): typeof fetch {
  return config.fetch ?? fetch
}

function extractEmail(answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers']): string | undefined {
  const emailAnswer = answers.find((a) => a.type === 'email' && a.email)
  return emailAnswer?.email
}

function extractName(answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers']): { firstName: string; lastName: string } | undefined {
  // Look for short_text or text fields that could be name
  // Typeform doesn't have explicit first/last name fields in the example
  // We'll treat the first text field as first name
  const nameAnswer = answers.find((a) => a.type === 'text' && a.text)
  if (!nameAnswer || !nameAnswer.text) return undefined
  
  const fullName = nameAnswer.text.trim()
  const parts = fullName.split(/\s+/)
  return {
    firstName: parts[0] ?? '',
    lastName: parts.slice(1).join(' ') || ''
  }
}

function determineListIds(
  answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers'],
  config: ConnectorConfig
): number[] {
  const listIds = new Set<number>()
  
  // Always include default list
  listIds.add(config.defaultListId)
  
  // Check for field ID mappings
  if (config.fieldIdToListId) {
    for (const answer of answers) {
      const mappedListId = config.fieldIdToListId[answer.field.id]
      if (mappedListId) listIds.add(mappedListId)
    }
  }
  
  return Array.from(listIds)
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<BrevoContactResult> {
  // Validate required config
  if (!config.brevoApiKey) {
    throw new Error('Missing required config: brevoApiKey')
  }
  if (!config.defaultListId || typeof config.defaultListId !== 'number') {
    throw new Error('Missing required config: defaultListId (must be a number)')
  }
  
  // Validate payload structure
  if (!payload.form_response?.answers?.length) {
    throw new Error('Invalid payload: missing form_response.answers')
  }
  
  const email = extractEmail(payload.form_response.answers)
  if (!email) {
    throw new Error('Required field missing: email not found in form answers')
  }
  
  const name = extractName(payload.form_response.answers)
  const listIds = determineListIds(payload.form_response.answers, config)
  
  // Build Brevo request body
  const body = {
    email,
    attributes: {
      FNAME: name?.firstName ?? '',
      LNAME: name?.lastName ?? ''
    },
    listIds
  }
  
  const fetchFn = getFetch(config)
  const response = await fetchFn('https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'api-key': config.brevoApiKey,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Accept: 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  })
  
  if (!response.ok) {
    const errorText = await response.text().catch(() => '')
    throw new Error(
      `Brevo API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} ` +
      `at POST https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts - ${errorText}`
    )
  }
  
  const result = (await response.json()) as { id: number }
  
  return {
    contactId: result.id,
    email,
    listIds
  }

<file path="README.md">
# Typeform to Brevo Contact Connector

Creates a Brevo contact from a Typeform form response webhook and subscribes the contact to one or more lists.

## What it does

1. Receives a Typeform `form_response` webhook payload
2. Extracts the respondent's email and name from the answers array
3. Creates a contact in Brevo via `POST https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts`
4. Subscribes the contact to configured list(s)

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `brevoApiKey` | `BREVO_API_KEY` | Yes | Brevo API key for authentication (sent as `api-key` header) |
| `defaultListId` | `BREVO_DEFAULT_LIST_ID` | Yes | Default numeric list ID to subscribe all contacts to |
| `fieldIdToListId` | `BREVO_FIELD_ID_TO_LIST_ID` | No | JSON object mapping Typeform field IDs to additional Brevo list IDs |

### Environment Variables

```bash
# Required
export BREVO_API_KEY="your-brevo-api-key"
export BREVO_DEFAULT_LIST_ID="123"

# Optional - JSON mapping of field IDs to list IDs
export BREVO_FIELD_ID_TO_LIST_ID='{"field-id-1": 456, "field-id-2": 789}'
```

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, TypeformWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  brevoApiKey: process.env.BREVO_API_KEY!,
  defaultListId: Number(process.env.BREVO_DEFAULT_LIST_ID),
  fieldIdToListId: JSON.parse(process.env.BREVO_FIELD_ID_TO_LIST_ID || '{}')
}

// In your webhook handler:
const result = await handle(typeformPayload as TypeformWebhookPayload, config)
console.log(`Created contact ${result.contactId} for ${result.email}`)
```

## Field Mapping

| Typeform Source | Brevo Target | Notes |
|-----------------|--------------|-------|
| `answers[].email` (type: email) | `email` | Required |
| `answers[].text` (type: text/short_text) | `attributes.FNAME` | First word becomes first name |
| `answers[].text` (type: text/short_text) | `attributes.LNAME` | Remaining words become last name |
| `fieldIdToListId` config | `listIds` | Merged with `defaultListId`, deduplicated |

## Assumptions

1. The Typeform webhook payload includes the respondent's email under an `email` type answer and name under a `text` type answer
2. The Brevo API accepts attributes in uppercase (`FNAME`, `LNAME`) which must exist in the Brevo account
3. The `listIds` array expects numeric list IDs from the Brevo UI or `/v3/lists` endpoint
4. If a contact already exists, Brevo returns 400 unless `updateEnabled: true` is set (not currently supported by this connector)
5. The webhook endpoint must be HTTPS (Typeform requirement)

## Error Handling

- Throws descriptive errors for missing required fields (email, config values)
- Throws on non-2xx Brevo responses with status code, endpoint, and response body
- Validates payload structure before making API calls

export interface DocumentedEndpoint {
  method: string
  /** As documented; may contain placeholders such as {id}, :id, <id> or a region host like usX. */
  url: string
  response: unknown
}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */
export const TARGET_ENDPOINTS: DocumentedEndpoint[] = [
  {
    "method": "POST",
    "url": "https://api.brevo.com/v3/contacts",
    "response": {
      "id": 12345
    }
  }
]

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  githubOwner: string
  githubRepo: string
  githubToken: string
  zendeskSubdomain: string
  zendeskAccessToken: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface ZendeskTicketCreatedPayload {
  type: string
  account_id: number
  id: string
  time: string
  zendesk_event_version: string
  subject: string
  detail: {
    id: string
    subject: string
    description: string
    status: string
    priority: string
    requester_id: string
    submitter_id: string
    assignee_id: string | null
    organization_id: string
    group_id: string
    tags: string[]
    via: { channel: string }
    created_at: string
    updated_at: string
  }
}

export interface HandleResult {
  githubIssueUrl: string
  zendeskTicketId: string
}

async function fetchWithRetry(
  fetchFn: typeof fetch,
  url: string,
  init: RequestInit,
  maxRetries = 3,
  baseMs = 1000,
): Promise<Response> {
  let lastError: Error | null = null
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt <= maxRetries; attempt++) {
    const res = await fetchFn(url, init)
    if (res.status === 429 || (res.status >= 500 && res.status < 600)) {
      const retryAfter = res.headers.get('retry-after')
      let delayMs: number
      if (retryAfter) {
        const asSec = Number(retryAfter)
        if (!Number.isNaN(asSec)) {
          delayMs = asSec * 1000
        } else {
          const date = new Date(retryAfter)
          delayMs = Number.isNaN(date.getTime()) ? baseMs * 2 ** attempt : Math.max(0, date.getTime() - Date.now())
        }
      } else {
        delayMs = baseMs * 2 ** attempt
      }
      if (delayMs > 0 && !Number.isNaN(delayMs)) {
        await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, delayMs))
      }
      lastError = new Error(`Retryable status ${res.status} on ${init.method ?? 'POST'} ${url}`)
      continue
    }
    if (!res.ok) {
      throw new Error(`HTTP ${res.status} on ${init.method ?? 'POST'} ${url}`)
    }
    return res
  }
  throw lastError ?? new Error(`Max retries exceeded on ${init.method ?? 'POST'} ${url}`)
}

export async function handle(
  payload: ZendeskTicketCreatedPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchFn = config.fetch ?? fetch

  if (!payload.detail?.id) throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.id')
  if (!payload.detail?.subject) throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.subject')
  if (!payload.detail?.description) throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.description')

  const ticketId = payload.detail.id
  const title = payload.detail.subject
  const body = payload.detail.description

  const githubUrl = `https://api.github.com/repos/${config.githubOwner}/${config.githubRepo}/issues`
  const githubRes = await fetchWithRetry(fetchFn, githubUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.githubToken}`,
      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'X-GitHub-Api-Version': '2022-11-28',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ title, body }),
  })
  const githubData = (await githubRes.json()) as { html_url: string }
  const githubIssueUrl = githubData.html_url

  const zendeskUrl = `https://${config.zendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/${ticketId}.json`
  const commentBody = `GitHub issue created: ${githubIssueUrl}`
  await fetchWithRetry(fetchFn, zendeskUrl, {
    method: 'PUT',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.zendeskAccessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({
      ticket: {
        comment: {
          body: commentBody,
          public: true,
        },
      },
    }),
  })

  return { githubIssueUrl, zendeskTicketId: ticketId }
}
