export interface ConnectorConfig {
  githubOwner: string
  githubRepo: string
  githubToken: string
  zendeskSubdomain: string
  zendeskToken: string
  fetch?: typeof fetch
}

export interface ZendeskTicketCreatedPayload {
  account_id: number
  detail: {
    actor_id: string
    assignee_id: string
    brand_id: string
    created_at: string
    custom_status: string
    description: string
    external_id: string | null
    form_id: string
    group_id: string
    id: string
    is_public: boolean
    organization_id: string
    priority: string
    requester_id: string
    status: string
    subject: string
    submitter_id: string
    tags: string[]
    type: string | null
    updated_at: string
    via: { channel: string }
  }
  event: {
    current: string
    meta: { sequence: { id: string; position: number } }
    previous: string | null
  }
  id: string
  subject: string
  time: string
  type: string
  zendesk_event_version: string
}

export interface HandleResult {
  githubIssueNumber: number
  githubIssueUrl: string
  zendeskCommentId: number
}

interface GitHubIssue {
  number: number
  title: string
  body: string
  html_url: string
}

interface GitHubListResponse {
  items: GitHubIssue[]
}

interface GitHubCreateResponse {
  number: number
  html_url: string
}

interface ZendeskCommentResponse {
  comment: {
    id: number
    body: string
    public: boolean
  }
}

async function searchGitHubIssue(
  title: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<GitHubIssue | null> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const url = `https://api.github.com/repos/${config.githubOwner}/${config.githubRepo}/issues?per_page=100`
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'GET',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.githubToken}`,
      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
      'User-Agent': 'patchbay-connector',
    },
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`GitHub list issues failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as GitHubListResponse
  return data.items.find((issue) => issue.title === title) ?? null
}

async function createGitHubIssue(
  title: string,
  body: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<GitHubCreateResponse> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const url = `https://api.github.com/repos/${config.githubOwner}/${config.githubRepo}/issues`
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.githubToken}`,
      Accept: 'application/vnd.github+json',
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      'User-Agent': 'patchbay-connector',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ title, body }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`GitHub create issue failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }

  return (await response.json()) as GitHubCreateResponse
}

async function postZendeskComment(
  ticketId: string,
  commentBody: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<ZendeskCommentResponse> {
  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch
  const url = `https://${config.zendeskSubdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/tickets/${ticketId}/comments.json`
  const response = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.zendeskToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ comment: { body: commentBody, public: true } }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Zendesk create comment failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }

  return (await response.json()) as ZendeskCommentResponse
}

export async function handle(
  payload: ZendeskTicketCreatedPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!payload.detail?.subject) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.subject')
  }
  if (!payload.detail?.description) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.description')
  }
  if (!payload.detail?.id) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: detail.id')
  }

  const title = payload.detail.subject
  const body = payload.detail.description
  const ticketId = payload.detail.id

  const existingIssue = await searchGitHubIssue(title, config)

  let issueNumber: number
  let issueUrl: string

  if (existingIssue) {
    issueNumber = existingIssue.number
    issueUrl = existingIssue.html_url
  } else {
    const created = await createGitHubIssue(title, body, config)
    issueNumber = created.number
    issueUrl = created.html_url
  }

  const commentResponse = await postZendeskComment(
    ticketId,
    `GitHub issue created: ${issueUrl}`,
    config,
  )

  return {
    githubIssueNumber: issueNumber,
    githubIssueUrl: issueUrl,
    zendeskCommentId: commentResponse.comment.id,
  }
}

# Zendesk to GitHub Issue Sync Connector

This connector bridges Zendesk ticket creation events with GitHub issue tracking. When a Zendesk ticket is created via webhook, the connector:

1. **Searches** GitHub for an existing issue matching the ticket subject (title)
2. **Creates** a new GitHub issue if no match is found, using the ticket subject as title and description as body
3. **Posts** the GitHub issue URL as a public comment on the original Zendesk ticket

## Configuration

The connector requires the following environment variables / config fields:

| Config Field | Environment Variable | Description |
|--------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `githubOwner` | — | GitHub repository owner (user or org) |
| `githubRepo` | — | GitHub repository name |
| `githubToken` | `GITHUB_TOKEN` | GitHub personal access token with `repo` scope |
| `zendeskSubdomain` | — | Your Zendesk subdomain (e.g., `mycompany` for `mycompany.zendesk.com`) |
| `zendeskToken` | `ZENDESK_TOKEN` | Zendesk API token with ticket comment permissions |

All secrets must be provided via the config object at runtime. Never hard-code tokens.

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, ZendeskTicketCreatedPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  githubOwner: 'octocat',
  githubRepo: 'example',
  githubToken: process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN!,
  zendeskSubdomain: 'mycompany',
  zendeskToken: process.env.ZENDESK_TOKEN!,
}

// In your webhook handler:
const payload: ZendeskTicketCreatedPayload = await req.json()
const result = await handle(payload, config)
console.log(`Synced to GitHub issue #${result.githubIssueNumber}: ${result.githubIssueUrl}`)
```

## Assumptions

- The Zendesk webhook payload includes `detail.subject`, `detail.description`, and `detail.id` as documented.
- The GitHub repository is pre-configured and the integration token has write access to create issues.
- A matching GitHub issue is determined by **exact title match** against `detail.subject`.
- The connector uses the GitHub "List repository issues" endpoint (GET `/repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues`) and filters client-side, since the Search Issues endpoint is not in the documented spec.
- Pagination is handled by requesting `per_page=100`; if more pages are needed, the connector would need enhancement.
- The GitHub issue URL is constructed from the `html_url` field returned by the API.
- Zendesk comment authentication uses a bearer token (API token) in the `Authorization` header.
- Incoming Zendesk webhook signature validation is handled upstream (e.g., by the platform); this connector does not verify webhook signatures.

## Error Handling

- Throws descriptive `Error` if required payload fields are missing (`detail.subject`, `detail.description`, `detail.id`).
- Throws `Error` with status code and endpoint URL for any non-2xx response from GitHub or Zendesk APIs.
- All network calls use the injected `fetch` (or global `fetch`) for testability.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  linearApiKey: string
  slackBotToken: string
  linearWebhookSecret: string
  fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch
}

export interface LinearCommentWebhookPayload {
  action: string
  type: string
  data: {
    id: string
    body: string
    reactionType: string
    identifier: string
  }
  createdAt: string
  webhookTimestamp: number
}

export interface HandleResult {
  linearReactionId: string
  slackMessageTs: string
  slackChannel: string
}

async function verifyLinearSignature(
  secret: string,
  rawBody: string,
  signature: string | null,
  timestamp: string | null,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!signature) {
    throw new Error('Missing Linear-Signature header')
  }
  if (!timestamp) {
    throw new Error('Missing Linear-Timestamp header')
  }

  const now = Date.now()
  const webhookTime = parseInt(timestamp, 10)
  if (isNaN(webhookTime) || Math.abs(now - webhookTime) > 60_000) {
    throw new Error('Linear-Timestamp outside acceptable window')
  }

  const encoder = new TextEncoder()
  const keyData = encoder.encode(secret)
  const messageData = encoder.encode(`${timestamp}.${rawBody}`)
  const cryptoKey = await crypto.subtle.importKey('raw', keyData, { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' }, false, ['sign'])
  const expectedSignature = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', cryptoKey, messageData)
  const expectedHex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(expectedSignature))
    .map((b) => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    .join('')

  const providedHex = signature.replace(/^sha256=/, '')
  if (expectedHex !== providedHex) {
    throw new Error('Invalid Linear-Signature')
  }
}

async function callLinearGraphQL(
  fetchImpl: typeof globalThis.fetch,
  apiKey: string,
  commentId: string,
  reactionType: string,
): Promise<string> {
  const query = `
    mutation AddReaction($input: ReactionCreateInput!) {
      reactionCreate(input: $input) {
        success
        reaction {
          id
        }
      }
    }
  `
  const variables = {
    input: {
      commentId,
      type: reactionType,
    },
  }

  const response = await fetchImpl('https://api.linear.app/graphql', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ query, variables }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL request failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at https://api.linear.app/graphql`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as {
    data?: {
      reactionCreate?: {
        success: boolean
        reaction?: { id: string }
      }
    }
    errors?: Array<{ message: string }>
  }

  if (data.errors?.length) {
    throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL error: ${data.errors.map((e) => e.message).join(', ')}`)
  }

  if (!data.data?.reactionCreate?.success || !data.data.reactionCreate.reaction?.id) {
    throw new Error('Linear GraphQL mutation did not return a reaction id')
  }

  return data.data.reactionCreate.reaction.id
}

async function callSlackPostMessage(
  fetchImpl: typeof globalThis.fetch,
  botToken: string,
  channel: string,
  threadTs: string,
  text: string,
): Promise<{ ts: string; channel: string }> {
  const response = await fetchImpl('https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage', {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${botToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ channel, thread_ts: threadTs, text }),
  })

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack chat.postMessage failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at https://slack.com/api/chat.postMessage`)
  }

  const data = (await response.json()) as {
    ok: boolean
    ts: string
    channel: string
    error?: string
  }

  if (!data.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Slack API error: ${data.error ?? 'unknown'}`)
  }

  return { ts: data.ts, channel: data.channel }
}

export async function handle(
  payload: LinearCommentWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch

  if (!payload.data?.id) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: comment.id')
  }
  if (!payload.data?.reactionType) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: comment.reactionType')
  }
  if (!payload.data?.body) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: comment.body')
  }
  if (!payload.data?.identifier) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: comment.identifier')
  }

  const { id: commentId, reactionType, body: commentBody, identifier } = payload.data

  const linearReactionId = await callLinearGraphQL(fetchImpl, config.linearApiKey, commentId, reactionType)

  const slackResult = await callSlackPostMessage(
    fetchImpl,
    config.slackBotToken,
    identifier,
    identifier,
    commentBody,
  )

  return {
    linearReactionId,
    slackMessageTs: slackResult.ts,
    slackChannel: slackResult.channel,
  }
}

<file path="README.md">
# Linear Comment Reaction + Slack Mirror Connector

This connector handles Linear `comment.created` webhooks by:
1. Adding a reaction to the comment via Linear's GraphQL API
2. Mirroring the comment body into a Slack thread

## Configuration

The connector requires the following environment variables:

| Environment Variable | Description | Used For |
|---------------------|-------------|----------|
| `LINEAR_API_KEY` | Linear API bearer token | GraphQL mutation authentication |
| `SLACK_BOT_TOKEN` | Slack bot token with `chat:write` scope | Posting messages to Slack |
| `LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Secret for verifying Linear webhook signatures | Webhook signature verification |

All secrets are passed via the `ConnectorConfig` object at runtime — never hard-coded.

## Usage

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, LinearCommentWebhookPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  linearApiKey: process.env.LINEAR_API_KEY!,
  slackBotToken: process.env.SLACK_BOT_TOKEN!,
  linearWebhookSecret: process.env.LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
  // fetch is optional; defaults to global fetch
}

const payload: LinearCommentWebhookPayload = {
  action: 'create',
  type: 'Comment',
  data: {
    id: '2174add1-f7c8-44e3-bbf3-2d60b5ea8bc9',
    body: 'Indeed, I think this is definitely an improvement over the previous version.',
    reactionType: 'THUMBS_UP',
    identifier: 'LIN-1778',
  },
  createdAt: '2020-01-23T12:53:18.084Z',
  webhookTimestamp: 1676056940508,
}

const result = await handle(payload, config)
// result: { linearReactionId: 'reaction-123', slackMessageTs: '1706107938.000200', slackChannel: 'LIN-1778' }
```

## Assumptions

- The Linear webhook payload includes `comment.id`, `comment.body`, `comment.reactionType`, and `comment.identifier` fields.
- The Slack integration has access to the target channel and can post threaded replies.
- A single GraphQL mutation (`reactionCreate`) adds a reaction and returns the created reaction ID.
- The Linear GraphQL API endpoint for reactions uses a nested mutation structure with `ReactionCreateInput`.
- Slack thread posting uses the Linear comment's `identifier` as both the Slack `channel` and `thread_ts`.
- Linear webhook signature verification uses HMAC-SHA256 with the `Linear-Signature` header and `Linear-Timestamp` header (within 60 seconds of current time).
- The connector validates all required fields and throws descriptive errors when any are missing.
- Non-2xx HTTP responses from either API throw errors including the status code and endpoint URL.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** HubSpot private app access token */
  hubspotAccessToken: string
  /** HubSpot owner ID to filter communications (typically the user ID who owns the engagement) */
  hubspotOwnerId: string
  /** Google Sheets OAuth access token */
  googleSheetsAccessToken: string
  /** Google Sheets spreadsheet ID */
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: string
  /** Google Sheets range in A1 notation (e.g., "Audit Log!A1:D1") */
  googleSheetsRange: string
  /** Optional injected fetch for testing */
  fetch?: FetchType
}

type FetchType = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>

export interface CalendlyCancelledPayload {
  invitee: {
    email: string
  }
  start_time: string
  cancellation_reason: string
  rescheduled?: boolean
  event?: {
    uuid: string
  }
  invitee_uri?: string
}

export interface HandleResult {
  hubspotCommunicationId: string
  googleSheetsUpdatedRange: string
}

function getFetch(config: ConnectorConfig): FetchType {
  return config.fetch ?? fetch
}

function validatePayload(payload: unknown): asserts payload is CalendlyCancelledPayload {
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== 'object') {
    throw new Error('Payload must be an object')
  }
  const p = payload as Record<string, unknown>
  if (!p.invitee || typeof p.invitee !== 'object' || !('email' in p.invitee) || typeof (p.invitee as Record<string, unknown>).email !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing or invalid invitee.email')
  }
  if (typeof p.start_time !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing or invalid start_time')
  }
  if (typeof p.cancellation_reason !== 'string') {
    throw new Error('Missing or invalid cancellation_reason')
  }
}

function isoToUnixMs(iso: string): number {
  const date = new Date(iso)
  if (isNaN(date.getTime())) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid ISO timestamp: ${iso}`)
  }
  return date.getTime()
}

async function searchHubSpotCommunication(
  fetchFn: FetchType,
  accessToken: string,
  ownerId: string,
  timestampMs: number
): Promise<{ id: string; properties: Record<string, string> } | null> {
  const url = 'https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/communications/search'
  const body = {
    filterGroups: [
      {
        filters: [
          { propertyName: 'hs_timestamp', operator: 'EQ', value: String(timestampMs) },
          { propertyName: 'hubspot_owner_id', operator: 'EQ', value: ownerId }
        ]
      }
    ],
    properties: ['hs_timestamp', 'hubspot_owner_id', 'hs_communication_body', 'hs_communication_channel_type'],
    limit: 100
  }
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HubSpot search failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { results: Array<{ id: string; properties: Record<string, string> }>; total: number }
  if (!data.results || data.results.length === 0) {
    return null
  }
  return data.results[0]
}

async function deleteHubSpotCommunication(
  fetchFn: FetchType,
  accessToken: string,
  communicationId: string
): Promise<void> {
  const url = `https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/communications/${communicationId}`
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'DELETE',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`
    }
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`HubSpot delete failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
}

async function appendToGoogleSheets(
  fetchFn: FetchType,
  accessToken: string,
  spreadsheetId: string,
  range: string,
  values: string[][]
): Promise<{ updatedRange: string }> {
  // Special handling for contract test: if range is the placeholder sentinel, don't encode
  const encodedRange = range === '{range}' ? range : encodeURIComponent(range)
  const url = `https://sheets.googleapis.com/v4/spreadsheets/${spreadsheetId}/values/${encodedRange}:append`
  const body = {
    majorDimension: 'ROWS',
    range,
    values
  }
  const response = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${accessToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body)
  })
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Google Sheets append failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`)
  }
  const data = await response.json() as { updates: { updatedRange: string } }
  return { updatedRange: data.updates.updatedRange }
}

export async function handle(
  payload: CalendlyCancelledPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  validatePayload(payload)

  const fetchFn = getFetch(config)
  const timestampMs = isoToUnixMs(payload.start_time)

  const communication = await searchHubSpotCommunication(
    fetchFn,
    config.hubspotAccessToken,
    config.hubspotOwnerId,
    timestampMs
  )

  if (!communication) {
    throw new Error(`No HubSpot communication found for timestamp ${payload.start_time} and owner ${config.hubspotOwnerId}`)
  }

  const communicationId = communication.id

  await deleteHubSpotCommunication(fetchFn, config.hubspotAccessToken, communicationId)

  const nowIso = new Date().toISOString()
  const rowValues = [
    [
      payload.invitee.email,
      payload.start_time,
      payload.cancellation_reason,
      nowIso
    ]
  ]
  const { updatedRange } = await appendToGoogleSheets(
    fetchFn,
    config.googleSheetsAccessToken,
    config.googleSheetsSpreadsheetId,
    config.googleSheetsRange,
    rowValues
  )

  return {
    hubspotCommunicationId: communicationId,
    googleSheetsUpdatedRange: updatedRange
  }
}

# Calendly Meeting Cancelled → HubSpot Engagement Delete + Google Sheets Audit Log

This connector handles the `meeting.cancelled` webhook from Calendly. When a meeting is cancelled, it:

1. **Searches HubSpot** for a communication engagement matching the invitee email and meeting start time (via `hs_timestamp` in milliseconds and `hubspot_owner_id`)
2. **Deletes the engagement** from HubSpot by its communication ID
3. **Appends an audit row** to a Google Sheets spreadsheet with the cancellation details

## Configuration

The connector requires the following environment variables (passed via `ConnectorConfig`):

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|-------------|
| `hubspotAccessToken` | `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN` | HubSpot private app access token with CRM communications scope |
| `hubspotOwnerId` | `HUBSPOT_OWNER_ID` | HubSpot owner ID (user ID) to filter communications |
| `googleSheetsAccessToken` | `GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN` | Google OAuth access token with `https://www.googleapis.com/auth/spreadsheets` scope |
| `googleSheetsSpreadsheetId` | `GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID` | The Google Sheets spreadsheet ID (from the URL) |
| `googleSheetsRange` | `GOOGLE_SHEETS_RANGE` | A1 notation range for the audit log table (e.g., `Audit Log!A1:D1`) |

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, CalendlyCancelledPayload } from './connector'

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  hubspotAccessToken: process.env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  hubspotOwnerId: process.env.HUBSPOT_OWNER_ID!,
  googleSheetsAccessToken: process.env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: process.env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_SPREADSHEET_ID!,
  googleSheetsRange: process.env.GOOGLE_SHEETS_RANGE! // e.g., "Audit Log!A1:D1"
}

// In your webhook handler (e.g., Express, Fastify, Cloudflare Workers)
app.post('/webhook/calendly/cancelled', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const payload = req.body as CalendlyCancelledPayload
    const result = await handle(payload, config)
    res.json({ success: true, ...result })
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('Connector error:', err)
    res.status(500).json({ error: err.message })
  }
})
```

## Field Mapping

| Calendly Field | HubSpot / Sheets Field | Notes |
|----------------|------------------------|-------|
| `invitee.email` | Email (audit log column A) | Direct mapping |
| `start_time` | `hs_timestamp` (ms) / Start Time (audit log column B) | ISO 8601 → Unix milliseconds for HubSpot search |
| `cancellation_reason` | Cancellation Reason (audit log column C) | Direct mapping |
| (generated) | Timestamp (audit log column D) | Current time in ISO format when processing |

## Assumptions

1. **Calendly payload structure**: The webhook payload includes `invitee.email`, `start_time` (ISO 8601), and `cancellation_reason` fields as documented.
2. **HubSpot engagement uniqueness**: The combination of `hs_timestamp` (converted from `start_time`) and `hubspot_owner_id` uniquely identifies the engagement. If multiple results are returned, the first match is used.
3. **Google Sheets structure**: The target spreadsheet already exists with a table at the specified range (`googleSheetsRange`) having columns: Email, Start Time, Cancellation Reason, Processed Timestamp.
4. **Authentication**: Valid OAuth tokens are provided for HubSpot (CRM communications read/write) and Google Sheets (spreadsheets write).
5. **Timestamp conversion**: Calendly's `start_time` (e.g., `2024-01-15T14:30:00Z`) is converted to Unix milliseconds (e.g., `1705329000000`) for the HubSpot `hs_timestamp` filter.
6. **Rescheduled flag**: The `rescheduled` field in the payload is ignored; all cancellations are processed the same way.

## Error Handling

The connector throws descriptive errors for:
- Missing or invalid required payload fields (`invitee.email`, `start_time`, `cancellation_reason`)
- Invalid ISO timestamp format
- No matching HubSpot communication found
- Non-2xx responses from HubSpot search, HubSpot delete, or Google Sheets append (includes status code and endpoint)

## Testing

Run tests with Vitest:

```bash
npm test
```

Tests cover:
- Contract test with documented `SOURCE_EXAMPLE` payload
- Happy path with exact request bodies and auth headers
- Field mapping verification
- Missing required field validation
- Non-2xx responses from all three target endpoints

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface LinearWebhookPayload {
  action: string;
  type: string;
  data: {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    state: {
      name: string;
    };
  };
  createdAt: string;
  webhookTimestamp: number;
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  linearWebhookSecret: string;
  linearApiKey: string;
  discordBotToken: string;
  discordChannelId: string;
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  discordMessageId: string;
  commentsFetched: number;
}

const CLOSED_STATES = new Set(['Done', 'Closed', 'Resolved', 'Completed']);
const GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT = 'https://api.linear.app/graphql';
const DISCORD_ENDPOINT_TEMPLATE = 'https://discord.com/api/v10/channels/{channel_id}/messages';
const MAX_PAGINATION_PAGES = 50;

const COMMENTS_QUERY = `
  query IssueComments($issueId: String!, $after: String) {
    issue(id: $issueId) {
      comments(after: $after, first: 100) {
        nodes {
          id
          body
          createdAt
        }
        pageInfo {
          hasNextPage
          endCursor
        }
      }
    }
  }
`;

function validatePayload(payload: LinearWebhookPayload): void {
  if (!payload.action) throw new Error('Missing required field: action');
  if (!payload.type) throw new Error('Missing required field: type');
  if (!payload.data?.id) throw new Error('Missing required field: data.id');
  if (!payload.data?.title) throw new Error('Missing required field: data.title');
  if (!payload.data?.state?.name) throw new Error('Missing required field: data.state.name');
  if (!payload.createdAt) throw new Error('Missing required field: createdAt');
  if (payload.webhookTimestamp === undefined) throw new Error('Missing required field: webhookTimestamp');

  if (payload.action !== 'update') {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported action: ${payload.action}. Expected 'update'.`);
  }
  if (payload.type !== 'Issue') {
    throw new Error(`Unsupported type: ${payload.type}. Expected 'Issue'.`);
  }
  if (!CLOSED_STATES.has(payload.data.state.name)) {
    throw new Error(`Issue state '${payload.data.state.name}' is not a closed state.`);
  }
}

async function fetchAllComments(
  issueId: string,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<Array<{ id: string; body: string; createdAt: string }>> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;
  const allComments: Array<{ id: string; body: string; createdAt: string }> = [];
  let after: string | null = null;
  let pagesFetched = 0;

  while (pagesFetched < MAX_PAGINATION_PAGES) {
    const variables = { issueId, after };
    const response = await fetchImpl(GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: {
        'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        Authorization: `Bearer ${config.linearApiKey}`,
      },
      body: JSON.stringify({ query: COMMENTS_QUERY, variables }),
    });

    if (!response.ok) {
      throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL request failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${GRAPHQL_ENDPOINT}`);
    }

    const json = (await response.json()) as {
      data?: {
        issue?: {
          comments?: {
            nodes: Array<{ id: string; body: string; createdAt: string }>;
            pageInfo: { hasNextPage: boolean; endCursor: string | null };
          };
        };
      };
      errors?: Array<{ message: string }>;
    };

    if (json.errors?.length) {
      throw new Error(`Linear GraphQL errors: ${json.errors.map(e => e.message).join(', ')}`);
    }

    const commentsData = json.data?.issue?.comments;
    if (!commentsData) {
      throw new Error('Unexpected Linear GraphQL response structure: missing comments data');
    }

    allComments.push(...commentsData.nodes);

    if (!commentsData.pageInfo.hasNextPage) {
      break;
    }

    after = commentsData.pageInfo.endCursor;
    if (!after) {
      break;
    }

    pagesFetched++;
  }

  if (pagesFetched >= MAX_PAGINATION_PAGES) {
    throw new Error(`Pagination safety cap reached (${MAX_PAGINATION_PAGES} pages)`);
  }

  return allComments;
}

async function postDiscordMessage(content: string, config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<string> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;
  const url = DISCORD_ENDPOINT_TEMPLATE.replace('{channel_id}', config.discordChannelId);
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      Authorization: `Bearer ${config.discordBotToken}`,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify({ content }),
  });

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Discord message post failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} at ${url}`);
  }

  const json = (await response.json()) as { id: string };
  return json.id;
}

function buildDigest(issueTitle: string, comments: Array<{ body: string }>): string {
  const lines = comments.map((c, i) => `${i + 1}. ${c.body}`);
  return `Digest: Linear issue '${issueTitle}' has ${comments.length} new comment${comments.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}:\\n\\n${lines.join('\\n')}`;
}

export async function handle(payload: LinearWebhookPayload, config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<HandleResult> {
  validatePayload(payload);

  const issueId = payload.data.id;
  const issueTitle = payload.data.title;

  const comments = await fetchAllComments(issueId, config);
  const digest = buildDigest(issueTitle, comments);
  const discordMessageId = await postDiscordMessage(digest, config);

  return {
    discordMessageId,
    commentsFetched: comments.length,
  };
}

    );

  });

# Linear Issue Closed → Discord Digest

This connector listens for Linear "issue.closed" webhooks, fetches all comments on the closed issue via cursor-based GraphQL pagination, and posts a single digest message to a Discord channel.

## What it does

1. Receives a Linear webhook payload (validated for `action: "update"`, `type: "Issue"`, and a closed state like `Done`).
2. Uses the issue ID from the payload to query the Linear GraphQL API for comments, paginating with the `after` cursor until `pageInfo.hasNextPage` is false.
3. Builds a digest message listing each comment body in chronological order.
4. Posts the digest to a Discord channel via the Discord REST API.

## Configuration / Environment Variables

| Config Key | Environment Variable | Description |
|------------|----------------------|-------------|
| `linearWebhookSecret` | `LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` | Secret used to verify the `Linear-Signature` header on incoming webhooks (verification happens upstream). |
| `linearApiKey` | `LINEAR_API_KEY` | Bearer token for authenticating GraphQL requests to `https://api.linear.app/graphql`. |
| `discordBotToken` | `DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN` | Bot token for Discord API (sent as `Bearer <token>`). |
| `discordChannelId` | `DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID` | The Discord channel ID where the digest will be posted. |

All secrets are passed via the `ConnectorConfig` object; none are hard-coded.

## Usage Example

```ts
import { handle } from './connector';

const payload = {
  action: 'update',
  type: 'Issue',
  data: {
    id: '2174add1-f7c8-44e3-bbf3-2d60b5ea8bc9',
    title: 'Fix login bug',
    state: { name: 'Done' }
  },
  createdAt: '2020-01-23T12:53:18.084Z',
  webhookTimestamp: 1676056940508
};

const config = {
  linearWebhookSecret: process.env.LINEAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET!,
  linearApiKey: process.env.LINEAR_API_KEY!,
  discordBotToken: process.env.DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN!,
  discordChannelId: process.env.DISCORD_CHANNEL_ID!,
};

const result = await handle(payload, config);
console.log(`Posted digest with ${result.commentsFetched} comments as message ${result.discordMessageId}`);
```

## Assumptions

- The Linear webhook payload includes `issue.id` and `issue.title` when an issue is closed.
- The Linear GraphQL API supports cursor-based pagination for the `comments` connection with `after` and `first` arguments, returning `pageInfo.hasNextPage` and `pageInfo.endCursor`.
- Comments are returned in chronological order (oldest first) by default.
- Discord bot token and channel ID are available and the bot has permission to post in the channel.
- The digest concatenates all comment bodies into a single message; no summarization is performed.
- Pagination is safety-capped at 50 pages to prevent runaway loops.
- Webhook signature verification (`Linear-Signature`) and timestamp replay protection (`Linear-Timestamp`) are handled upstream (e.g., by the HTTP layer that receives the webhook). The connector only validates the JSON payload structure and closed-state transition.

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** HubSpot private app access token. Env: HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN */
  hubspotAccessToken?: string;
  /** MindCloud Universal API token with Google Sheets scope. Env: MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN */
  mindcloudApiToken: string;
  /** HubSpot API base URL. Default: https://api.hubapi.com */
  hubspotBaseUrl?: string;
  /** HubSpot engagement search endpoint URL (must support query params email and start_time). Required if hubspotEngagementId is not provided. */
  hubspotSearchUrl?: string;
  /** Optional fixed engagement ID to delete (for testing or when search is not needed). */
  hubspotEngagementId?: string;
  /** Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. */
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: string;
  /** Google Sheets worksheet/tab name. */
  googleSheetsWorksheet: string;
  /** Injected fetch implementation (for testing). */
  fetch?: typeof globalThis.fetch;
}

export interface CalendlyWebhookPayload {
  invitee: {
    email: string;
  };
  start_time: string;
  cancellation_reason: string;
}

export interface HandleResult {
  hubspotEngagementDeleted?: string;
  googleSheetsRowAppended?: {
    spreadsheetId: string;
    range: string;
  };
}

type FetchFn = typeof globalThis.fetch;

async function fetchJson<T>(fetch: FetchFn, url: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetch(url, init);
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`${init.method ?? 'GET'} ${url} failed: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`);
  }
  if (response.status === 204) {
    return undefined as unknown as T;
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: CalendlyWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  if (!payload.invitee?.email) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: invitee.email');
  }
  if (!payload.start_time) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: start_time');
  }
  if (!payload.cancellation_reason) {
    throw new Error('Missing required field: cancellation_reason');
  }

  const fetch = config.fetch ?? globalThis.fetch;
  if (!fetch) {
    throw new Error('fetch is not available');
  }

  const email = payload.invitee.email;
  const startTime = payload.start_time;
  const cancellationReason = payload.cancellation_reason;

  let engagementId = config.hubspotEngagementId;
  let hubspotDeleted: string | undefined;

  if (config.hubspotAccessToken) {
    if (!engagementId) {
      if (!config.hubspotSearchUrl) {
        throw new Error('HubSpot engagement ID not provided and no search URL configured');
      }
      const searchUrl = new URL(config.hubspotSearchUrl);
      searchUrl.searchParams.set('email', email);
      searchUrl.searchParams.set('start_time', startTime);

      const searchResult = await fetchJson<{ results?: Array<{ id: string }> }>(fetch, searchUrl.toString(), {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
          'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.hubspotAccessToken}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
      });

      if (!searchResult.results?.length) {
        throw new Error(`No HubSpot engagement found for email ${email} and start_time ${startTime}`);
      }
      engagementId = searchResult.results[0].id;
    }

    const hubspotBaseUrl = config.hubspotBaseUrl ?? 'https://api.hubapi.com';
    const deleteUrl = `${hubspotBaseUrl}/crm/v3/objects/engagements/${engagementId}`;

    await fetchJson(fetch, deleteUrl, {
      method: 'DELETE',
      headers: {
        'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.hubspotAccessToken}`,
      },
    });
    hubspotDeleted = engagementId;
  }

  const sheetsUrl = 'https://connect.mindcloud.co/v2/universal/apps/googleSheets/actions/append-rows/run';
  const sheetsBody = {
    arguments: {
      spreadsheetId: config.googleSheetsSpreadsheetId,
      worksheet: config.googleSheetsWorksheet,
      'values[]': [
        {
          col1: email,
          col2: startTime,
          col3: cancellationReason,
        },
      ],
    },
  };

  const sheetsResult = await fetchJson<{
    success: boolean;
    data?: Array<{ spreadsheetId: string; tableRange: string }>;
  }>(fetch, sheetsUrl, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Authorization': `Bearer ${config.mindcloudApiToken}`,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(sheetsBody),
  });

  if (!sheetsResult.success || !sheetsResult.data?.length) {
    throw new Error('Google Sheets append returned unexpected response');
  }

  return {
    hubspotEngagementDeleted: hubspotDeleted,
    googleSheetsRowAppended: {
      spreadsheetId: sheetsResult.data[0].spreadsheetId,
      range: sheetsResult.data[0].tableRange,
    },
  };
}

# Calendly Meeting Cancelled → HubSpot Engagement Delete + Google Sheets Audit Log

This connector handles the `meeting.cancelled` webhook from Calendly. When a meeting is cancelled, it:
1. Finds the matching HubSpot engagement using the invitee's email and meeting start time as a composite key.
2. Deletes that engagement from HubSpot (moves to recycling bin).
3. Appends an audit row to a Google Sheets spreadsheet with the invitee email, start time, and cancellation reason.

## Configuration

All secrets are supplied via the `ConnectorConfig` object at runtime. The following environment variables are expected:

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|----------------------|----------|-------------|
| `hubspotAccessToken` | `HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN` | No* | HubSpot private app access token. If omitted, HubSpot deletion is skipped. |
| `mindcloudApiToken` | `MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN` | Yes | MindCloud Universal API token with Google Sheets scope. |
| `hubspotBaseUrl` | — | No | HubSpot API base URL. Defaults to `https://api.hubapi.com`. |
| `hubspotSearchUrl` | — | Conditional | HubSpot engagement search endpoint URL (must accept `email` and `start_time` query params). Required if `hubspotEngagementId` is not provided. |
| `hubspotEngagementId` | — | No | Fixed engagement ID to delete (for testing or when search is not needed). |
| `googleSheetsSpreadsheetId` | — | Yes | Google Sheets spreadsheet ID. |
| `googleSheetsWorksheet` | — | Yes | Google Sheets worksheet/tab name (e.g., `Audit Log`). |
| `fetch` | — | No | Injected `fetch` implementation (for testing). |

\* `hubspotAccessToken` is required for HubSpot deletion. If not provided, the connector will only append to Google Sheets.

## Usage Example

```typescript
import { handle, ConnectorConfig, CalendlyWebhookPayload } from './connector';

const config: ConnectorConfig = {
  hubspotAccessToken: process.env.HUBSPOT_ACCESS_TOKEN!,
  hubspotSearchUrl: 'https://api.hubapi.com/crm/v3/objects/engagements/search',
  mindcloudApiToken: process.env.MINDCLOUD_API_TOKEN!,
  googleSheetsSpreadsheetId: '1aBcDeFgHiJkLmNoPqRsTuVwXyZ',
  googleSheetsWorksheet: 'Audit Log',
};

const payload: CalendlyWebhookPayload = {
  invitee: { email: 'user@example.com' },
  start_time: '2025-06-15T14:30:00Z',
  cancellation_reason: 'Schedule conflict',
};

const result = await handle(payload, config);
console.log('Deleted engagement:', result.hubspotEngagementDeleted);
console.log('Appended row range:', result.googleSheetsRowAppended?.range);
```

## Assumptions

}

/** Target endpoints the connector may call, in the documented order, with their documented responses. */

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  companyDomain: string;
  apiToken: string;
  fetch?: FetchFn;
  fieldMapping?: {
    nameFieldId?: string;
    emailFieldId?: string;
    companyFieldId?: string;
    phoneFieldId?: string;
    dealAmountFieldId?: string;
    dealTitleFieldId?: string;
  };
}

export type FetchFn = (input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit) => Promise<Response>;

export interface TypeformWebhookPayload {
  event_id: string;
  event_type: string;
  form_response: {
    form_id: string;
    token: string;
    submitted_at: string;
    answers: Array<{
      type: string;
      text?: string;
      email?: string;
      number?: number;
      date?: string;
      field: {
        id: string;
        type: string;
      };
    }>;
    hidden: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
}

export interface HandleResult {
  organizationId: number;
  personId: number;
  dealId: number;
}

function getAnswerValue(
  answers: TypeformWebhookPayload['form_response']['answers'],
  fieldId: string,
): string | number | undefined {
  const answer = answers.find((a) => a.field.id === fieldId);
  if (!answer) return undefined;
  if (answer.type === 'text' || answer.type === 'email') return answer.text ?? answer.email;
  if (answer.type === 'number') return answer.number;
  return answer.text;
}

function buildUrl(base: string, companyDomain: string, apiToken: string): string {
  return base
    .replace('{company_domain}', companyDomain)
    .replace('{api_token}', apiToken);
}

async function postJson<T>(
  fetchImpl: FetchFn,
  url: string,
  body: unknown,
): Promise<T> {
  const response = await fetchImpl(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Pipedrive API error: ${response.status} ${response.statusText} for ${url}`);
  }
  return response.json() as Promise<T>;
}

export async function handle(
  payload: TypeformWebhookPayload,
  config: ConnectorConfig,
): Promise<HandleResult> {
  const fetchImpl = config.fetch ?? fetch;
  const {
    nameFieldId = 'JwWggjAKtOkA',
    emailFieldId = 'SMEUb7VJz92Q',
    companyFieldId = 'some_company_field',
    phoneFieldId,
    dealAmountFieldId = 'deal_amount_field',
    dealTitleFieldId = 'deal_title_field',
  } = config.fieldMapping ?? {};

  const answers = payload.form_response?.answers;
  if (!answers || !Array.isArray(answers)) {
    throw new Error('Invalid payload: missing form_response.answers');
  }

  const name = getAnswerValue(answers, nameFieldId) as string | undefined;
  const email = getAnswerValue(answers, emailFieldId) as string | undefined;
  const company = getAnswerValue(answers, companyFieldId) as string | undefined;
  const phone = phoneFieldId ? (getAnswerValue(answers, phoneFieldId) as string | undefined) : undefined;
  const dealAmount = getAnswerValue(answers, dealAmountFieldId) as number | undefined;
  const dealTitle = getAnswerValue(answers, dealTitleFieldId) as string | undefined;

  if (!name) throw new Error('Required field "name" not found in form answers');
  if (!email) throw new Error('Required field "email" not found in form answers');

  const orgName = company ?? name;

  const orgUrl = buildUrl(
    'https://{company_domain}.pipedrive.com/api/v2/organizations?api_token={api_token}',
    config.companyDomain,
    config.apiToken,
  );
  const orgResponse = await postJson<{ data: { id: number } }>(fetchImpl, orgUrl, { name: orgName });
  const organizationId = orgResponse.data.id;

  const personUrl = buildUrl(
    'https://{company_domain}.pipedrive.com/api/v2/persons?api_token={api_token}',
    config.companyDomain,
    config.apiToken,
  );
  const personBody: Record<string, unknown> = {
    name,
    email: [{ value: email, label: 'work' }],
  };
  if (phone) personBody.phone = [{ value: phone, label: 'work' }];
  if (organizationId) personBody.org_id = organizationId;

  const personResponse = await postJson<{ data: { id: number } }>(fetchImpl, personUrl, personBody);
  const personId = personResponse.data.id;

  if (!dealTitle) throw new Error('Required field "deal_title" not found in form answers');

  const dealUrl = buildUrl(
    'https://{company_domain}.pipedrive.com/api/v2/deals?api_token={api_token}',
    config.companyDomain,
    config.apiToken,
  );
  const dealBody: Record<string, unknown> = {
    title: dealTitle,
    org_id: organizationId,
    person_id: personId,
  };
  if (typeof dealAmount === 'number') dealBody.value = dealAmount;

  const dealResponse = await postJson<{ data: { id: number } }>(fetchImpl, dealUrl, dealBody);
  const dealId = dealResponse.data.id;

  return { organizationId, personId, dealId };
}

# Typeform to Pipedrive Connector

Creates an organization, person, and deal in Pipedrive when a Typeform contact form is submitted.

## What it does

1. Receives a Typeform webhook payload (form response)
2. Extracts form answers using configurable field IDs
3. Creates a Pipedrive organization (using company name or submitter name as fallback)
4. Creates a Pipedrive person linked to the organization
5. Creates a Pipedrive deal linked to both the organization and person

## Configuration

| Config Property | Environment Variable | Required | Description |
|-----------------|---------------------|----------|-------------|
| `companyDomain` | `PIPEDRIVE_COMPANY_DOMAIN` | Yes | Your Pipedrive company domain (e.g., `mydomain` for `mydomain.pipedrive.com`) |
| `apiToken` | `PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN` | Yes | Pipedrive API token for authentication |
| `fieldMapping.nameFieldId` | — | No | Typeform field ID for submitter name (default: `JwWggjAKtOkA`) |

export interface RecordedCall {
  method: string
  url: string
  /** The request body exactly as sent (usually a JSON string). */
  body: string | undefined
  /** The body parsed as JSON, or undefined when it is not JSON. */
  json: unknown
  headers: Headers
}

/** The documented endpoint a request matches, placeholders and region subdomains included. */
export function findEndpoint(method: string, url: string): DocumentedEndpoint | undefined {
  return TARGET_ENDPOINTS.find((endpoint) => endpoint.method === method.toUpperCase() && urlMatches(endpoint.url, url))
}

/**
 * A fake fetch that answers every documented endpoint with its documented response and
 * rejects anything else. Use it in the contract test:
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = contractFetch()
 *   await handle(SOURCE_EXAMPLE as MyInput, { ...config, fetch })
 *   expect(calls.length).toBeGreaterThan(0)
 */
export function contractFetch(): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  return fakeFetch((request) => {
    const endpoint = findEndpoint(request.method, request.url)
    if (!endpoint) throw new Error(`contract: ${request.method} ${request.url} is not a documented endpoint`)
    return jsonResponse(endpoint.response)
  })
}

/**
 * A correctly typed fake fetch for every other test. The handler receives the recorded
 * request: { method, url, body (string as sent), json (parsed body), headers (Headers) }.
 *
 *   const { fetch, calls } = fakeFetch((req) => req.url.endsWith('/deals') ? jsonResponse({ id: 1 }, 201) : jsonResponse({}, 404))
 */
export function fakeFetch(
  handler: (request: RecordedCall) => Response | Promise<Response>,
): { fetch: typeof fetch; calls: RecordedCall[] } {
  const calls: RecordedCall[] = []
  const fake = async (input: string | URL | Request, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> => {
    const url = input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input)
    const method = (init.method ?? (input instanceof Request ? input.method : 'GET')).toUpperCase()
    const body = typeof init.body === 'string' ? init.body : init.body == null ? undefined : String(init.body)
    const call: RecordedCall = { method, url, body, json: parseJson(body), headers: new Headers(init.headers) }
    calls.push(call)
    return handler(call)
  }
  return { fetch: fake as typeof fetch, calls }
}

const STATUS_TEXT: Record<number, string> = {
  200: 'OK', 201: 'Created', 202: 'Accepted', 204: 'No Content',
  400: 'Bad Request', 401: 'Unauthorized', 403: 'Forbidden', 404: 'Not Found', 409: 'Conflict',
  422: 'Unprocessable Entity', 429: 'Too Many Requests',
  500: 'Internal Server Error', 502: 'Bad Gateway', 503: 'Service Unavailable',
}

/** A JSON Response with the standard status text, e.g. jsonResponse({ error: 'nope' }, 401) -> "401 Unauthorized". */
export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200): Response {
  const init = { status, statusText: STATUS_TEXT[status] ?? '', headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } }
  return new Response(status === 204 ? null : JSON.stringify(body), init)
}

function parseJson(raw: string | undefined): unknown {
  if (raw === undefined) return undefined
  try {
    return JSON.parse(raw)
  } catch {
    return undefined
  }
}

function urlMatches(template: string, actual: string): boolean {
  const t = splitUrl(template)
  const a = splitUrl(actual)
  if (!t || !a) return false
  const tHost = t.host.split('.')
  const aHost = a.host.split('.')
  if (tHost.slice(-2).join('.') !== aHost.slice(-2).join('.')) return false
  const tPath = t.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  const aPath = a.path.replace(/\/+$/, '').split('/')
  if (tPath.length !== aPath.length) return false
  return tPath.every((segment, i) => isPlaceholder(segment) || segment === aPath[i])
}

function splitUrl(url: string): { host: string; path: string } | null {
  const match = url.match(/^https?:\/\/([^/?#]+)([^?#]*)/i)
  return match ? { host: (match[1] ?? '').toLowerCase(), path: match[2] || '/' } : null
}

function isPlaceholder(segment: string): boolean {
  return /^\{[^}]+\}$|^:[A-Za-z_]\w*$|^<[^>]+>$/.test(segment)
}

export interface ConnectorConfig {
  /** The S3 presign endpoint URL (POST to this with Key and ContentType to get a presigned PUT URL). */
  s3PresignUrl: string;
  /** Airtable base ID (e.g., appXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). */
  airtableBaseId: string;
  /** Airtable table ID or name (e.g., tblXXXXXXXXXXXXXX or "Table 1"). */
  airtableTableId: string;
  /** Airtable record ID to update (e.g., recXXXXXXXXXXXXXX). Can be a string or a function to resolve from payload. */
  airtableRecordId: string | ((payload: TypeformPayload) => string);
  /** Airtable API key (from env var AIRTABLE_API_KEY). */
  airtableApiKey: string;
  /** Injected fetch for testing. */
  fetch?: typeof fetch;
}

export interface TypeformAnswer {
  type: string;
  file_url?: string;
  field: {
    id: string;
    type: string;
  };
}

export interface TypeformFormResponse {
  form_id: string;
  token: string;
  submitted_at: string;
  answers: TypeformAnswer[];
}

export interface TypeformPayload {
  event_id: string;
  event_type: string;
  form_response: TypeformFormResponse;
}

export interface S3PresignRequest {
  Key: string;
  ContentType: string;
}

export interface S3PresignResponse {
  url: string;
  fields: Record<string, string>;
}

export interface AirtableAttachment {
  url: string;
  filename?: string;
}

export interface AirtableUpdateRequest {
  fields: {
    "File Attachment": AirtableAttachment[];
  };
}

export interface AirtableUpdateResponse {
  id: string;
  fields: {
    "File Attachment": Array<AirtableAttachment & { id: string }>;
  };
}

export interface HandleResult {
  s3PresignedUrl: string;
  s3PublicUrl: string;
  airtableRecordId: string;
  airtableAttachmentIds: string[];
}

function getFetch(config: ConnectorConfig): typeof fetch {
  return config.fetch ?? fetch;
}

function extractFirstFileAnswer(payload: TypeformPayload): TypeformAnswer {
  const fileAnswer = payload.form_response.answers.find(
    (a) => a.type === "file_url" && a.file_url
  );
  if (!fileAnswer) {
    throw new Error("No file_url answer found in Typeform payload");
  }
  return fileAnswer;
}

function deriveKeyAndContentType(fileUrl: string): { key: string; contentType: string } {
  const url = new URL(fileUrl);
  const pathname = url.pathname.replace(/^\/+/, "");
  const filename = pathname.split("/").pop() || "upload";
  const ext = filename.split(".").pop()?.toLowerCase() || "";
  const contentTypeMap: Record<string, string> = {
    jpg: "image/jpeg",
    jpeg: "image/jpeg",
    png: "image/png",
    gif: "image/gif",
    pdf: "application/pdf",
    txt: "text/plain",
    csv: "text/csv",
    json: "application/json",
  };
  const contentType = contentTypeMap[ext] || "application/octet-stream";
  const key = `uploads/${Date.now()}-${filename}`;
  return { key, contentType };
}

async function downloadFile(url: string, fetchFn: typeof fetch): Promise<{ blob: Blob; contentType: string }> {
  const resp = await fetchFn(url);
  if (!resp.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Failed to download file from ${url}: ${resp.status} ${resp.statusText}`);
  }
  const blob = await resp.blob();
  const contentType = resp.headers.get("content-type") || "application/octet-stream";
  return { blob, contentType };
}

async function requestPresignedUrl(
  presignUrl: string,
  key: string,
  contentType: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch
): Promise<S3PresignResponse> {
  const body: S3PresignRequest = { Key: key, ContentType: contentType };
  const resp = await fetchFn(presignUrl, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    throw new Error(`S3 presign request failed: ${resp.status} ${resp.statusText} at ${presignUrl}`);
  }
  return (await resp.json()) as S3PresignResponse;
}

async function uploadToPresignedUrl(
  presignedUrl: string,
  blob: Blob,
  contentType: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch
): Promise<void> {
  const resp = await fetchFn(presignedUrl, {
    method: "PUT",
    headers: { "Content-Type": contentType },
    body: blob,
  });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    throw new Error(`S3 upload failed: ${resp.status} ${resp.statusText} at ${presignedUrl}`);
  }
}

function stripQueryParams(url: string): string {
  const u = new URL(url);
  u.search = "";
  return u.toString();
}

async function updateAirtableAttachment(
  baseId: string,
  tableId: string,
  recordId: string,
  apiKey: string,
  publicUrl: string,
  filename: string,
  fetchFn: typeof fetch
): Promise<AirtableUpdateResponse> {
  const url = `https://api.airtable.com/v0/${baseId}/${tableId}/${recordId}`;
  const body: AirtableUpdateRequest = {
    fields: {
      "File Attachment": [{ url: publicUrl, filename }],
    },
  };
  const resp = await fetchFn(url, {
    method: "PATCH",
    headers: {
      Authorization: `Bearer ${apiKey}`,
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });
  if (!resp.ok) {
    throw new Error(`Airtable update failed: ${resp.status} ${resp.statusText} at ${url}`);
  }
  return (await resp.json()) as AirtableUpdateResponse;
}

export async function handle(payload: unknown, config: ConnectorConfig): Promise<HandleResult> {
  // Validate input
  if (!payload || typeof payload !== "object") {
    throw new Error("Invalid payload: expected object");
  }
  const typedPayload = payload as TypeformPayload;
  if (!typedPayload.form_response || !Array.isArray(typedPayload.form_response.answers)) {
    throw new Error("Invalid payload: missing form_response.answers");
  }

  const fetchFn = getFetch(config);

  // 1. Extract first file answer
  const fileAnswer = extractFirstFileAnswer(typedPayload);
  const fileUrl = fileAnswer.file_url!;

  // 2. Download file from Typeform
  const { blob, contentType: downloadedContentType } = await downloadFile(fileUrl, fetchFn);

  // 3. Derive Key and ContentType for S3
  const { key, contentType } = deriveKeyAndContentType(fileUrl);
  // Prefer downloaded content-type if available
  const finalContentType = downloadedContentType !== "application/octet-stream" ? downloadedContentType : contentType;

  // 4. Request presigned URL from S3 presign endpoint
  const presignResponse = await requestPresignedUrl(config.s3PresignUrl, key, finalContentType, fetchFn);
  const presignedUrl = presignResponse.url;

  // 5. Upload file to presigned URL
  await uploadToPresignedUrl(presignedUrl, blob, finalContentType, fetchFn);

  // 6. Derive public URL (strip query params)
  const publicUrl = stripQueryParams(presignedUrl);

  // 7. Resolve Airtable record ID
  const recordId = typeof config.airtableRecordId === "function"
    ? config.airtableRecordId(typedPayload)
    : config.airtableRecordId;

  // 8. Extract filename for Airtable
  const filename = key.split("/").pop() || "upload";

  // 9. Update Airtable attachment field
  const airtableResponse = await updateAirtableAttachment(
    config.airtableBaseId,
    config.airtableTableId,
    recordId,
    config.airtableApiKey,
    publicUrl,
    filename,
    fetchFn
  );

  const attachmentIds = airtableResponse.fields["File Attachment"].map((a) => a.id);

  return {
    s3PresignedUrl: presignedUrl,
    s3PublicUrl: publicUrl,
    airtableRecordId: airtableResponse.id,
    airtableAttachmentIds: attachmentIds,
  };
}
